Fuse box location

Passenger compartment fuse panel / Power distribution box

The fuse panel is located under the right-hand side of the instrument panel behind the cover.

Remove the trim panel and fuse box cover to access the fuses.To remove the fuse box cover, place a finger behind the PULL tab and your thumb above the PULL tab as shown in the illustration, then pull the cover off.

To reinstall the fuse box cover, place the top part of the cover on the fuse panel, then push the bottom part of the cover until you hear it click shut. Gently pull on the cover to make sure it is seated properly.

Auxiliary relay box

The relay box is located in the engine compartment on the left fender.

#### Ford F-150 | 2009-2014
The twelfth-generation Ford F-150, a powerful and versatile full-size pickup truck, was produced from 2009 to 2014. Known for its robust performance, advanced features, and enduring durability, this generation remains a popular choice for both work and leisure.

In this article, you will find fuse box diagrams for Ford F-150 models produced between 2009 and 2014, including years 2009, 2010, 2011, 2012, 2013, and 2014. These diagrams provide essential insights into the fuse layout, helping owners and technicians efficiently maintain and troubleshoot the vehicle’s electrical systems.

What’s Included:

Fuse Box Diagrams: Clear and detailed visuals for quick identification of fuses and relays.

Fuse Panel Locations: Step-by-step instructions to locate the fuse panels inside your Ford F-150.

Fuse Assignments: Comprehensive descriptions of each fuse and relay’s function for accurate diagnostics and repairs.

Whether you’re replacing a blown fuse, addressing electrical issues, or performing regular maintenance, this guide is an indispensable resource for Ford F-150 owners and technicians. It ensures your vehicle’s systems remain functional and reliable.

Maintain the performance and reliability of your Ford F-150 (2009–2014) with this detailed fuse box guide!

The cigar lighter (power outlet) fuses in the Ford F-150 are:

Fuse №22: Cigar Lighter

Fuse №33: 110V AC Power Point (since 2011)

Fuse №65: Auxiliary Power Point (Instrument Panel)

Fuse №66: Auxiliary Power Point (Inside Center Console)

Fuse №72: Auxiliary Power Point (Rear)

All are located in the Engine Compartment Fuse Box.

Fuse box location

Ford F-150 Fuse Panel Locations (2009-2014)

Passenger compartment

The fuse panel is located under the right-hand side of the instrument panel behind the cover.

To remove the trim panel for access to the fuse box, pull the panel toward you and swing it out away from the side and remove it.

To reinstall it, line up the tabs with the grooves on the panel, then push it shut. To remove the fuse box cover, press in the tabs on both sides of the cover, then pull the cover off.To reinstall the fuse box cover, place the top part of the cover on the fuse panel, then push the bottom part of the cover until you hear it click shut. Gently pull on the cover to make sure it is seated properly.

Engine compartment

The power distribution box is located in the engine compartment.

Auxiliary relay box (SVT Raptor only)

The relay box is located in the left rear corner of the engine compartment.

#### Ford F-150 | 2015-2020
The thirteenth-generation Ford F-150, a durable and versatile full-size pickup truck, was available from 2015 to 2020. Featuring a lightweight aluminum body, advanced technology, and powerful performance, this generation continues to be a favorite among truck enthusiasts for both work and recreational use.

In this article, you will find fuse box diagrams for Ford F-150 models produced between 2015 and 2020, including years 2015, 2016, 2017, 2018, 2019, and 2020. These diagrams provide detailed insights into the fuse layout, helping owners and technicians effectively troubleshoot and maintain the vehicle’s electrical systems.

What’s Included:

Fuse Box Diagrams: Clear visuals for quick identification of fuses and relays.

Fuse Panel Locations: Step-by-step guidance on locating the fuse panels inside your Ford F-150.

Fuse Assignments: Comprehensive descriptions of the purpose of each fuse and relay for accurate diagnostics and repairs.

Whether you’re addressing an electrical issue, replacing a blown fuse, or conducting routine maintenance, this guide is an essential resource for Ford F-150 owners and technicians. It ensures that your vehicle’s systems remain functional and dependable.

Keep your Ford F-150 (2015–2020) running at its best with this detailed fuse box guide!

The cigar lighter (power outlet) fuses in the Ford F150 are as follows:

2015–2017 (Engine Compartment Fuse Box):

Fuse №89: Cigar Lighter Power Point 1

Fuse №90: Power Point 2

Fuse №91: Power Point 3

Fuse №92: Power Point 4

Since 2018 (Engine Compartment Fuse Box):

Fuse №6: Cigar Lighter Power Point 1

Fuse №8: Cigar Lighter Power Point 2

Fuse №51: Power Point 3

Fuse box location

Passenger compartment

The fuse panel is in the right-hand side of the passenger footwell behind a trim panel.

To remove the trim panel, pull it toward you and swing it away from the side.To reinstall it, line up the tabs with the grooves on the panel, and then push it shut.

To remove the fuse panel cover, press in the tabs on both sides of the cover, and then pull it off.To reinstall the fuse panel cover, place the top part of the cover on the fuse panel and push the bottom part until it latches. Gently pull on the cover to make sure it has latched properly.

Engine compartment

The power distribution box is located in the engine compartment.

Fuse box locationPassenger compartmentEngine compartmentUPFITTER CONTROLS (IF EQUIPPED)Relay boxFuse box diagrams2011-2013Passenger compartmentEngine compartmentUPFITTER CONTROLS (IF EQUIPPED)2014Passenger compartmentEngine compartment2015-2016Passenger compartmentEngine compartment
Fuse box location

Passenger compartment

The fuse panel is located in the passenger’s footwell behind the cover.

Engine compartment

The power distribution box is located in the engine compartment.

UPFITTER CONTROLS (IF EQUIPPED)

The upfitter option package includes four switches located in the center of the instrument panel. These switches will function only when the ignition is turned on, regardless of whether the engine is running. However, it is advisable to keep the engine running to ensure battery charge is maintained during prolonged use or when drawing higher current. This recommendation is particularly crucial for vehicles equipped with diesel engines, as glow plugs also consume battery power while the ignition key remains in the on position.

When activated, they deliver 8 amps, 12 amps, or 20 amps of electrical power from the battery for various personal or commercial applications.

Relay box

A relay box will be positioned at the driver’s side end of the instrument panel. Please consult your authorized dealer for assistance. Additionally, there will be a power lead for each switch, presented as a blunt-cut and sealed wire situated beneath the instrument panel, to the left of the steering column.

#### Ford F-250 / F-350 / F-450 / F-550 | 2017-2019
The fourth-generation Ford F-Series Super Duty, engineered for heavy-duty towing, hauling, and commercial applications, was available from 2017 to 2019. With its high-strength aluminum body, powerful engine options, and advanced towing technology, the F-250, F-350, F-450, and F-550 remain top choices for fleet operators, business owners, and off-road enthusiasts.

In this article, you will find fuse box diagrams for Ford F-250, F-350, F-450, and F-550 models produced between 2017 and 2019, covering years 2017, 2018, and 2019. These diagrams provide essential insights into the fuse layout, helping truck owners, fleet managers, and mechanics locate and understand the function of each fuse and relay.

What’s Included:

Fuse Box Diagrams – Clear and detailed visuals to help identify fuses, relays, and circuit breakers.

Fuse Panel Locations – Step-by-step guidance on where to find the fuse panels inside the Ford Super Duty trucks.

Fuse Assignments – Comprehensive descriptions of each fuse and relay function for accurate diagnostics and troubleshooting.

Whether you&#8217;re searching for the fuse panel layout, replacing a blown fuse, or diagnosing an electrical issue, this guide is an invaluable resource. It ensures that your Ford F-Series Super Duty electrical system remains functional and reliable for work, towing, and off-road performance.

Keep your Ford F-250, F-350, F-450, and F-550 (2017–2019) operating at peak performance with this detailed fuse box, fuse panel, and relay guide!

The cigar lighter (power outlet) fuses in the Ford F-250 / F-350 / F-450 / F-550 are as follows (all located in the Engine Compartment Fuse Box):

Fuse №22: (2017: Auxiliary Power Point #5 – Rear Console)

Fuse №62: Auxiliary Power Point #1 – Instrument Panel

Fuse №64: Auxiliary Power Point #2

Fuse №66: Auxiliary Power Point #3 – Center Console

Fuse №68: Auxiliary Power Point #4 – Rear Media Bin

Fuse №70: (2018–2019: Auxiliary Power Point #5 – Rear Center Console)

#### Ford F650 / F750 | 2000-2015
The seventh-generation Ford F-650 and F-750, designed for heavy-duty commercial applications, were produced from 2000 to 2015. These medium-duty trucks offered robust performance, durability, and versatility, making them a trusted choice for industries requiring reliable work vehicles.

In this article, you will find fuse box diagrams for Ford F-650 and F-750 models produced between 2000 and 2015, covering years 2000, 2001, 2002, 2003, 2004, 2005, 2006, 2007, 2008, 2009, 2010, 2011, 2012, 2013, 2014, and 2015. These diagrams provide essential insights into the fuse layout, helping fleet managers, mechanics, and truck owners locate and understand the function of each fuse and relay.

What’s Included:

Fuse Box Diagrams – Clear and detailed visuals to help identify fuses, relays, and circuit breakers.

Fuse Panel Locations – Step-by-step guidance on where to find the fuse panels inside the Ford F-650 and F-750.

Fuse Assignments – Comprehensive descriptions of the function of each fuse and relay for accurate diagnostics and troubleshooting.

Whether you’re searching for the fuse panel layout, replacing a blown fuse, or diagnosing an electrical issue, this guide is an essential resource. It ensures that your Ford F-650 / F-750’s electrical system remains functional and reliable for heavy-duty operations.

Keep your Ford F-650 / F-750 (2000–2015) running at its best with this detailed fuse box, fuse panel, and relay guide!

The cigar lighter (power outlet) fuses in the Ford F-650 / F-750 are:

Fuse No.104 (Power Point) in the Battery Junction Box (Engine Compartment)

Fuse No.3 (Cigar Lighter) in the Central Junction Box (Passenger Compartment)

Inline fuses

Your vehicle could have multiple inline fuses situated in or on the battery cables within the battery compartment, depending on the specific application.

All vehicles equipped with Allison transmissions feature a 10 Amp fuse found within the clean power cables in the battery compartment.

Every vehicle is equipped with a 30 Amp fuse situated within the clean power cables found in the battery compartment.

All vehicles that are fitted with an Eaton transmission contain a 30 Amp fuse found within the clean power cables in the battery compartment.

All vehicles equipped with hydraulic brakes feature a 40 Amp fuse in the clean power cables within the battery box, along with an additional 30 Amp fuse situated in a fuse holder just above the power distribution center in the engine compartment.

#### Ford F650 / F750 | 2016-2020
The eighth-generation Ford F-650 and F-750, designed for heavy-duty commercial applications, have been available from 2016 to 2020. These medium-duty trucks offer exceptional durability, power, and customization options, making them a go-to choice for businesses requiring reliable work vehicles.

In this article, you will find fuse box diagrams for Ford F-650 and F-750 models produced between 2016 and 2020, covering years 2016, 2017, 2018, 2019, and 2020. These diagrams provide essential insights into the fuse layout, helping fleet managers, technicians, and owners locate and understand the function of each fuse and relay.

What’s Included:

Fuse Box Diagrams – Clear and detailed visuals to help identify fuses, relays, and circuit breakers.

Fuse Panel Locations – Step-by-step guidance on where to find the fuse panels inside the Ford F-650 and F-750.

Fuse Assignments – Comprehensive descriptions of each fuse and relay’s function for accurate diagnostics and troubleshooting.

Whether you’re looking for the fuse panel layout, replacing a blown fuse, or diagnosing an electrical issue, this guide is an essential resource. It ensures that your Ford F-650 / F-750’s electrical system remains functional and reliable for heavy-duty operations.

Keep your Ford F-650 / F-750 (2016–2020) running at its best with this detailed fuse box, fuse panel, and relay guide!

The cigar lighter (power outlet) fuses in the Ford F-650 / F-750 are fuse No.82 and fuse No.83, located in the Engine Compartment Fuse Box.

#### Ford Fiesta | 2002-2008
The fifth-generation Ford Fiesta (Model Code: BE256), a practical and fuel-efficient subcompact car, was produced from 2002 to 2008. Known for its reliability, affordability, and improved driving dynamics, this version of the Fiesta became a popular choice for urban drivers and small families.

In this article, you will find fuse box diagrams for Ford Fiesta models produced between 2002 and 2008, covering years 2002, 2003, 2004, 2005, 2006, 2007, and 2008. These diagrams provide essential information about the fuse layout, helping owners and technicians locate and understand the function of each fuse and relay.

What’s Included:

Keep your Ford Fiesta (2002–2008) in top condition with this detailed fuse box, fuse panel, and relay guide!

The cigar lighter (power outlet) fuses in the Ford Fiesta are:

Fuse F29 (Cigar Lighter)

Fuse F51 (Auxiliary Power Socket)

Both are located in the Instrument Panel Fuse Box.

Fuse Box Location

Passenger Compartment

The fuse box is located behind the glove box. Open the glove box, squeeze its walls and fold it down.

Engine Compartment

The main fuse box is attached to the battery mounting wall (remove the battery, press the latch and remove the unit).The relay box is located next to the battery (press the two clips together with a screwdriver and remove it).

In this article, you will find fuse box diagrams for Ford Five Hundred models produced between 2005 and 2007, covering years 2005, 2006, and 2007. #### Ford Flex | 2009-2012
The Ford Flex, in its pre-facelift version, was produced from 2009 to 2012. With its distinctive boxy design, spacious interior, and smooth driving dynamics, the Flex became a popular choice for families and long-distance travelers.

In this article, you will find fuse box diagrams for Ford Flex models produced between 2009 and 2012, covering years 2009, 2010, 2011, and 2012. These diagrams provide crucial details about the fuse layout and relay assignments, helping owners and technicians effectively maintain and troubleshoot the vehicle’s electrical systems.

#### Ford Flex | 2013-2019
The Ford Flex, following its 2013 facelift, was available from 2013 to 2019. Known for its distinctive boxy design, spacious interior, and smooth performance, the Flex remained a popular choice for families seeking comfort and versatility.

In this article, you will find fuse box diagrams for Ford Flex models produced between 2013 and 2019, covering years 2013, 2014, 2015, 2016, 2017, 2018, and 2019. These diagrams provide essential details about the fuse layout and relay assignments, helping owners and technicians effectively maintain and troubleshoot the vehicle’s electrical systems.

What’s Included:

Fuse Box Diagrams: Clear and detailed visuals for easy identification of fuses and relays.

Fuse Panel Locations: Step-by-step instructions on where to find the fuse panels inside your Ford Flex.

Fuse Assignments: Comprehensive descriptions of the function of each fuse and relay for accurate diagnostics and repairs.

Whether you’re replacing a blown fuse, diagnosing an electrical issue, or performing routine maintenance, this guide is an invaluable resource for Ford Flex (2013–2019) owners and technicians. It ensures the vehicle’s systems remain functional and reliable.

Keep your Ford Flex (2013–2019) running at its best with this detailed fuse box guide!

The cigar lighter (power outlet) fuses in the Ford Flex are:

Fuse №6 (Since 2016: Center Console Power Point)

Fuse №9 (2nd Row Console Power Point)

Fuse №17 (110V AC Power Point)

Fuse №20 (Inside Bin Power Point)

Fuse №21 (Instrument Panel Power Point / Cigar Lighter)

Fuse №27 (Cargo Power Point)

All are located in the Engine Compartment Fuse Box.

#### Ford Focus (Electric)
The Ford Focus Electric, based on the third-generation Ford Focus (Mk3), was produced from 2012 to 2018. As Ford&#8217;s first fully electric vehicle, it combined the practicality of the Focus hatchback with zero-emission driving, offering an efficient and eco-friendly alternative for urban commuters.

In this article, you will find fuse box diagrams for Ford Focus Electric models produced between 2012 and 2018, covering years 2012, 2013, 2014, 2015, 2016, 2017, and 2018. These diagrams provide essential insights into the fuse layout and relay assignments, helping owners and technicians effectively troubleshoot and maintain the vehicle’s electrical systems.

What’s Included:

Fuse Box Diagrams: Clear and detailed visuals for quick identification of fuses and relays.

Fuse Panel Locations: Step-by-step instructions on where to locate the fuse panels inside your Ford Focus Electric.

Fuse Assignments: Comprehensive descriptions of each fuse and relay’s function for accurate diagnostics and repairs.

The cigar lighter (power outlet) fuse is fuse №61 (Front Cigar Lighter Socket, Rear Auxiliary Power Points) located in the Instrument Panel Fuse Box.

Fuse box location

Passenger compartment

The fuse panel is located on the right side below the glove box.

Engine compartment

The power distribution box is located in the engine compartment.

Pre-Fuse Box

It is located in the electric motor compartment on the front of the 12-volt battery box. It is connected to the 12-volt battery positive terminal.

Luggage&nbsp;compartment

The fuse panel is located in the luggage compartment behind the left side wheel well.

#### Ford Focus | 1999-2009
The first-generation Ford Focus, a revolutionary compact car, was produced from 1999 to 2009. Known for its sharp handling, innovative design, and practicality, this model quickly became a favorite among drivers worldwide.

In this article, you will find fuse box diagrams for Ford Focus models produced between 1999 and 2009, covering years 1999, 2000, 2001, 2002, 2003, 2004, 2005, 2006, 2007, 2008, and 2009. These diagrams provide crucial details about the fuse layout and relay assignments, helping owners and technicians effectively maintain and troubleshoot the vehicle’s electrical systems.

Whether you’re replacing a blown fuse, diagnosing an electrical issue, or performing routine maintenance, this guide is an essential resource for Ford Focus (1999–2009) owners and technicians. It ensures the vehicle’s systems remain functional and reliable.

Keep your Ford Focus (1999–2009) in excellent condition with this detailed fuse box guide!

The cigar lighter (power outlet) fuses in the Ford Focus are:

Fuse №39 (If Equipped)

Fuse №46 (1999–2001)

Fuse №47 (Since 2002)

All are located in the Instrument Panel Fuse Box.

#### Ford Focus | 2008-2011
The second-generation Ford Focus (North America) was produced from 2008 to 2011 and featured a refreshed design, improved efficiency, and updated technology. This version of the Focus remained a reliable choice for compact car enthusiasts seeking practicality and affordability.

In this article, you will find fuse box diagrams for Ford Focus models produced between 2008 and 2011, covering years 2008, 2009, 2010, and 2011. These diagrams provide essential information about the fuse layout and relay assignments, helping owners and technicians effectively maintain and troubleshoot the vehicle’s electrical systems.

What’s Included:

Fuse Box Diagrams: Clear and detailed visuals for quick identification of fuses and relays.

Fuse Panel Locations: Step-by-step instructions on where to find the fuse panels inside your Ford Focus.

Fuse Assignments: Comprehensive descriptions of each fuse and relay’s function for accurate diagnostics and repairs.

Whether you’re replacing a blown fuse, diagnosing an electrical issue, or performing routine maintenance, this guide is an essential resource for Ford Focus (2008–2011) owners and technicians. It ensures the vehicle’s systems remain functional and reliable.

Keep your Ford Focus (2008–2011) running efficiently with this detailed fuse box guide!

The cigar lighter (power outlet) fuses are:

Fuse №3: Power Point

Fuse №15: Front Power Point

Both are located in the Engine Compartment Fuse Box.

#### Ford Focus | 2012-2014
The third-generation Ford Focus, prior to its 2015 facelift, was produced from 2012 to 2014. Featuring a modern design, improved fuel efficiency, and advanced technology, this version of the Focus gained popularity as a reliable and stylish compact car.

In this article, you will find fuse box diagrams for Ford Focus models produced between 2012 and 2014, covering years 2012, 2013, and 2014. These diagrams provide crucial details about the fuse layout and relay assignments, helping owners and technicians efficiently maintain and troubleshoot the vehicle’s electrical systems.

What’s Included:

Fuse box location

Passenger compartment

The fuse panel is located on the right side below the glove box (remove the glove-box bottom).

Engine compartment

The power distribution box is located in the engine compartment.

Luggage compartment

The fuse panel is located in the luggage compartment behind the left side wheel well.

#### Ford Focus | 2015-2018
The third-generation Ford Focus, following its 2015 facelift, was produced from 2015 to 2018. With updated styling, enhanced technology, and improved efficiency, this version of the Focus continued to be a popular choice among drivers seeking a practical yet fun-to-drive compact car.

In this article, you will find fuse box diagrams for Ford Focus models produced between 2015 and 2018, covering years 2015, 2016, 2017, and 2018. These diagrams provide essential information about the fuse layout and relay assignments, helping owners and technicians troubleshoot and maintain the vehicle’s electrical systems effectively.

What’s Included:

Fuse Box Diagrams: Clear and detailed visuals for quick identification of fuses and relays.

Fuse Panel Locations: Step-by-step instructions on where to locate the fuse panels inside your Ford Focus.

Fuse Assignments: Comprehensive descriptions of the function of each fuse and relay for accurate diagnostics and repairs.

Whether you’re replacing a blown fuse, diagnosing an electrical issue, or performing routine maintenance, this guide is an invaluable resource for Ford Focus (2015–2018) owners and technicians. It ensures the vehicle’s systems remain functional and reliable.

Keep your Ford Focus (2015–2018) running smoothly with this detailed fuse box guide!

Fuse box location

Passenger compartment

The fuse panel is located under the instrument panel to the left of the steering column (behind the trim panel below the steering wheel).

Engine compartment

The power distribution box is located in the engine compartment.

There are fuses located on the bottom of the fusebox

To access the bottom of the fuse box, do the following:

1. Release the two latches, located on both sides of the fusebox.2. Raise the inboard side of the fusebox from the cradle.3. Move the fusebox toward the center of the engine compartment.4. Pivot the outboard side of the fusebox to access the bottom side.

#### Ford Fusion Energi / Hybrid | 2013-2020
The Ford Fusion Hybrid and Fusion Energi, innovative and eco-friendly sedans, were produced from 2013 to 2020. Known for their fuel efficiency, advanced technology, and comfortable interiors, these models catered to drivers seeking sustainability without compromising performance.

In this article, you will find fuse box diagrams for Ford Fusion Hybrid and Fusion Energi models produced between 2013 and 2020, covering years 2013, 2014, 2015, 2016, 2017, 2018, 2019, and 2020. These diagrams provide crucial details about the fuse layout and relay assignments, helping owners and technicians efficiently maintain and troubleshoot the vehicle’s electrical systems.

Keep your Ford Fusion Hybrid / Fusion Energi (2013–2020) in excellent condition with this detailed fuse box guide!

The cigar lighter / power outlet fuses in the Ford Fusion Hybrid / Energi are:

Fuse №5: Power Point 3 – Back of Console

Fuse №10: Power Point 1 – Driver Front

Fuse №16: Power Point 2 – Console

All are located in the Engine Compartment Fuse Box.

Fuse box location

Passenger compartment

The fuse panel is located under the instrument panel to the left of the steering column (behind the trim panel below the steering wheel).

Engine compartment

The power distribution box is located in the engine compartment.

There are fuses located on the bottom of the fuse box

To access the bottom of the fusebox, do the following:

1. Release the two latches, located on both sides of the fusebox.2. Raise the inboard side of the fusebox from the cradle.3. Move the fusebox toward the center of the engine compartment.4. Pivot the outboard side of the fusebox to access the bottom side.

#### Ford GT | 2017-2022
The second-generation Ford GT, a high-performance supercar with advanced aerodynamics and cutting-edge technology, was available from 2017 to 2022. Known for its stunning design and powerful EcoBoost engine, the Ford GT continues to be a symbol of innovation and performance in the automotive world.

In this article, you will find fuse box diagrams for Ford GT models produced between 2017 and 2022, covering years 2017, 2018, 2019, 2020, 2021, and 2022. These diagrams provide essential details about the fuse layout and relay assignments, helping owners and technicians effectively maintain and troubleshoot the vehicle’s electrical systems.

What’s Included:

Fuse Box Diagrams: Clear visuals for quick and accurate identification of fuses and relays.

Fuse Panel Locations: Step-by-step instructions on where to locate the fuse panels inside your Ford GT.

Fuse Assignments: Comprehensive descriptions of each fuse and relay’s function for accurate diagnostics and repairs.

Whether you are replacing a blown fuse, addressing an electrical issue, or performing regular maintenance, this guide is an indispensable resource for Ford GT (2017–2022) owners and technicians. It ensures the vehicle’s electrical systems remain reliable and functional.

Keep your Ford GT (2017–2022) performing at its peak with this detailed fuse box guide!

The cigar lighter (power outlet) fuse in the Ford GT is fuse No.36, located in the Instrument Panel Fuse Box.

What’s Included
Toggle
Fuse box locationPassenger compartmentUnderhood compartmentFuse box diagramsPassenger compartmentFront Power Distribution BoxRear Power Distribution Box 1Rear Power Distribution Box 2 (2018-2022)
Fuse box location

Passenger compartment

The fuse panel is in the passenger footwell behind the toeboard panel.

To remove the toeboard panel, rotate each of the four fasteners, and then pull the toeboard panel toward you. Once you remove this panel, you can access the fuse panel. After replacing a fuse, reinstall the toeboard panel and rotate the fasteners back to their original position.

Underhood compartment

Power Distribution Box – Bottom

Fuse box location

There are fuses located on the bottom of the fusebox.

To access, do the following:1) Release the two latches, located on both sides of the fusebox.2) Raise the inboard side of the fusebox from the cradle.3) Move the fusebox toward the center of the engine compartment.4) Pivot the outboard side of the fusebox to access the bottom side.

Fuse box location

Passenger compartment

The fuse panel is located in the lower passenger side area behind the kick panel.

Engine compartment

Fuse box is located in the engine compartment.

Auxiliary relay (if equipped)

A relay is positioned on the accelerator pedal assembly for the PCM delay. 

Note: This is applicable only to manual transmission models.

Auxiliary relay with heated seats (if equipped)

In vehicles with heated seats, a relay box is positioned behind the headlamp switch area. This box contains two micro relays, one for the driver’s heated seat and another for the passenger&#8217;s heated seat.

Auxiliary relay with HID headlamps (if equipped)

In vehicles that feature HID headlamps, an auxiliary relay box is situated under the hood on the front right side of the engine compartment. This relay box houses the relays for both the left front and right front HID headlamps.

#### Ford Mustang | 2010-2014
The fifth-generation Ford Mustang (S-197), following its 2010 facelift, was produced from 2010 to 2014. With updated styling, advanced features, and improved performance, this version of the Mustang continued to captivate sports car enthusiasts around the world.

In this article, you will find fuse box diagrams for Ford Mustang models produced between 2010 and 2014, covering years 2010, 2011, 2012, 2013, and 2014. These diagrams provide essential information about the fuse layout and relay assignments, helping owners and technicians effectively troubleshoot and maintain the vehicle’s electrical systems.

What’s Included:

Fuse Box Diagrams: Clear, detailed visuals for easy identification of fuses and relays.

Fuse Panel Locations: Step-by-step guidance on where to locate the fuse panels inside your Ford Mustang.

Fuse Assignments: Comprehensive descriptions of the purpose of each fuse and relay for accurate diagnostics and repairs.

Whether you are replacing a blown fuse, addressing an electrical issue, or performing regular maintenance, this guide is an invaluable resource for Ford Mustang (2010–2014) owners and technicians. It ensures the vehicle’s systems remain functional and reliable.

Keep your Ford Mustang (2010–2014) running at its best with this detailed fuse box guide!

The cigar lighter (power outlet) fuses are fuse No.5 and fuse No.22, located in the Engine Compartment Fuse Box.

Fuse box location

Passenger compartment

The fuse panel is located in the lower passenger side area behind the kick panel.

Engine compartment

The power distribution box is located in the engine compartment.

Auxiliary relay with heated seats (if equipped)

In vehicles with heated seats, there is a relay box situated beneath the driver&#8217;s seat that houses two relays—one for the driver’s heated seat and another for the passenger&#8217;s.

#### Ford Mustang | 2014-2023
The sixth-generation Ford Mustang S550, a global icon of performance and style, has been available from 2014 to 2023. With its aggressive design, modern technology, and impressive performance capabilities, this generation solidifies the Mustang&#8217;s reputation as a quintessential sports car.

In this article, you will find fuse box diagrams for Ford Mustang models produced between 2014 and 2023, including years 2014, 2015, 2016, 2017, 2018, 2019, 2020, 2021, 2022, and 2023. These diagrams provide crucial details about the fuse layout and relay assignments, helping owners and technicians troubleshoot and maintain the vehicle’s electrical systems effectively.

What’s Included:

Fuse Box Diagrams: Clear visuals for quick and accurate identification of fuses and relays.

Fuse Panel Locations: Step-by-step instructions on where to find the fuse panels inside your Ford Mustang.

Fuse Assignments: Comprehensive descriptions of the function of each fuse and relay for diagnostics and repairs.

Whether you’re replacing a blown fuse, diagnosing an electrical issue, or performing routine maintenance, this guide is an essential resource for Ford Mustang owners and technicians. It ensures the vehicle’s electrical systems remain functional and reliable.

Keep your Ford Mustang (2014–2023) in peak condition with this detailed fuse box guide!

The cigar lighter (power outlet) fuses in the Ford Mustang are fuse No.53 (Cigar Lighter) and fuse No.54 (Auxiliary Power Point), both located in the Engine Compartment Fuse Box.

Fuse box location

Passenger compartment

The fuse panel is in the right-hand side of the passenger footwell behind a trim panel and plastic key code card.

To remove the trim panel, lift it from the rear retaining hooks, while pulling it toward you and swinging it away from the side.To reinstall it, line up the tabs with the grooves on the panel, drop the panel back into place, and then push it shut.To reach the fuse panel, first remove the key code card.

Engine compartment

Fuse box is located in the engine compartment.

Body Control Module Fuse Box

Under Hood Fuse Box

Remove the luggage compartment cover.

Pull the latch toward you and remove the top cover.

Pull the connector lever upward.

Pull the connector upward to remove it.

Pull both latches toward you and remove the fuse box.

Turn the fuse box over and open the lid.

Installing and removing the luggage compartment cover

Rear Luggage Compartment Cover

Start at the rear edge of the left-hand side.

Pull upward at the clip locations shown to release the clips.

Remove the cover.

To install, reverse the removal procedure.

Left-Hand / Right-Hand Luggage Compartment Covers

Start at the rear edge of the right-hand side (or the left-hand side) and work toward the front of the cover.

Pull upward at the clip locations shown to release the clips.

Remove the cover.

To install, reverse the removal procedure.

Fuse box location

Passenger compartment

The fuse panel is located below and outboard of the steering column behind the access cover.

Engine compartment

The power distribution box is located in the engine compartment (left-side).

Power Distribution Box – Bottom

There are fuses located on the bottom of the fuse box.

To access, do the following:1. Release the two latches, located on both sides of the fusebox;2. Raise the rear side of the fusebox from the cradle;3. Move the fusebox toward the rear side of the engine compartment and rotate as shown;4. Pivot the rear side of the fusebox to access the bottom side;5. Release the two latches to open the cover.

Pre-fuse Box #1

It is attached to the positive battery terminal.

Pre-fuse Box #2

It is located below the engine compartment fuse box.

#### Ford Taurus | 2000-2007
The fourth-generation Ford Taurus, a full-size sedan known for its reliability, comfort, and affordability, was produced from 2000 to 2007. This model solidified its place as a practical choice for families and commuters, offering a balance of performance and functionality.

In this article, you will find fuse box diagrams for Ford Taurus models produced between 2000 and 2007, covering years 2000, 2001, 2002, 2003, 2004, 2005, 2006, and 2007. These diagrams provide critical information about the fuse layout and relay assignments, helping owners and technicians effectively troubleshoot and maintain the vehicle’s electrical systems.

What’s Included:

Fuse Box Diagrams: Clear and detailed visuals for quick identification of fuses and relays.

Fuse Panel Locations: Step-by-step instructions on where to locate the fuse panels inside your Ford Taurus.

Fuse Assignments: Comprehensive descriptions of each fuse and relay’s function for accurate diagnostics and repairs.

Whether you are addressing an electrical issue, replacing a fuse, or conducting regular maintenance, this guide is an invaluable resource for Ford Taurus owners and technicians. It ensures the vehicle’s systems remain functional and reliable.

Maintain the reliability and performance of your Ford Taurus (2000–2007) with this detailed fuse box guide!

The cigar lighter (power outlet) fuse in the Ford Taurus varies by model year:

2000: Fuse No.13 in the Instrument Panel Fuse Box

2001–2003:

Fuse No.13 in the Instrument Panel Fuse Box

Fuse No.18 in the Engine Compartment Fuse Box

Since 2004: Fuses No.25 and No.29 in the Instrument Panel Fuse Box

Fuse Panel Locations: Step-by-step guidance on where to find the fuse panels inside your vehicle.

Fuse Assignments: Comprehensive descriptions of each fuse and relay’s function for diagnostics and repairs.

Whether you’re replacing a blown fuse, addressing an electrical issue, or conducting regular maintenance, this guide is an essential resource for Ford Transit and Ford Tourneo owners and technicians. It ensures the vehicle’s systems operate efficiently and reliably.

Maintain the reliability and performance of your Ford Transit and Ford Tourneo (2013–2019) with this detailed fuse box guide!

The cigar lighter (power outlet) fuses in the Ford Transit and Ford Tourneo are:

Fuse F8 (2013–2017: AC Power Outlet Socket)

Fuse F44 (Auxiliary Power Points)

Fuse F47 (Cigar Lighter Socket)

Fuse F48 (Rear Auxiliary Power Points)

Fuse F49 (Front Auxiliary Power Points)

All are located in the Instrument Panel Fuse Box.

Fuse box location

Passenger compartment

This is located behind the removable trim panel below the steering wheel.

Pre-fuse Box

This is located under the driver’s seat.

Body Control Module Fuse Box

This is located behind the removable trim panel.

Engine compartment

The Engine Compartment Fuse Box is located in the engine compartment.

Fuse Box Locations

In this Ford Transit/Tourneo Courier, there are two fuse boxes: one is under the hood, and the other, the Body Control Module, is located in the interior. Below, I will show you where to find them.

Engine Compartment

The fuse box is located on the right side of the engine compartment when viewed from the front.

Passenger Compartment

Left-Hand drive vehicles Body Control Module location.

The fuse box is located behind the glove compartment.To access it:

Open the glove compartment and empty its contents.

Turn the retaining clips to release them.

Press the sides of the glove compartment inward and lower it downward.

Right-Hand drive vehicles Body Control Module location.

The fuse box is located below the glove compartment; carefully remove the cover.

Fuse box assignments are different for gasoline and diesel engines.

#### Ford Transit/Tourneo Custom | 2016-2018
The facelifted first-generation Ford Transit Custom and Ford Tourneo Custom, versatile and practical commercial vans, were produced from 2016 to 2018. Known for their updated styling, improved features, and dependable performance, these models are a popular choice for businesses and passenger transport.

In this article, you will find fuse box diagrams for Ford Transit Custom and Ford Tourneo Custom models produced between 2016 and 2018, covering years 2016, 2017, and 2018. These diagrams provide detailed information about the fuse layout and relay assignments, helping owners and technicians troubleshoot and maintain the vehicle’s electrical systems.

What’s Included:

Fuse Box Diagrams: Easy-to-read visuals for quick identification of fuses and relays.

Fuse Panel Locations: Clear instructions on where to locate the fuse panels inside the vehicle.

Fuse Assignments: Comprehensive explanations of the function of each fuse and relay for diagnostics and repairs.

Whether you are addressing electrical issues, replacing a fuse, or conducting regular maintenance, this guide is an essential resource for owners and mechanics. It ensures your Ford Transit Custom or Ford Tourneo Custom operates reliably and efficiently.

Keep your Ford Transit Custom and Ford Tourneo Custom (2016–2018) in top condition with this detailed fuse box guide!

The cigar lighter (power outlet) fuses in the Ford Transit/Tourneo (except 2.2L Diesel models) are F6, F7, F13, F14, F30, and F71 (230V) located in the Instrument Panel Fuse Box.

#### Ford Transit/Tourneo Custom | 2019-2022
The facelifted first-generation Ford Transit/Tourneo Custom, a versatile and reliable light commercial van, was produced from 2019 to 2022. Known for its updated design, improved technology, and practicality, this version of the Transit Custom remains a popular choice for businesses and individuals seeking a dependable workhorse.

In this article, you will find fuse box diagrams for Ford Transit Custom models produced between 2019 and 2022, covering years 2019, 2020, 2021, and 2022. These diagrams provide essential details about the fuse layout and relay assignments, making it easy to troubleshoot and maintain the vehicle’s electrical systems.

What’s Included:

Fuse Box Diagrams: Clear and detailed visuals to quickly identify fuses and relays.

Fuse Panel Locations: Step-by-step guidance on locating the fuse panels inside your Ford Transit Custom.

Fuse Assignments: Comprehensive descriptions of each fuse and relay’s function to assist with diagnostics and repairs.

Whether you&#8217;re addressing electrical issues, replacing a blown fuse, or performing routine maintenance, this guide is an invaluable resource for Ford Transit Custom owners and technicians. It ensures you have the knowledge needed to keep your vehicle’s electrical systems operating efficiently.

Fuses Box Location

Passenger Compartment

Two fuse boxes are located behind the removable trim panel below the steering wheel – the Fuse Box is on the right, and the Body Control Module is on the left (on vehicles with right-hand drive – on the contrary).

Pre-fuse Box

This is located under the driver’s seat.

#### Ford Transit/Tourneo Custom | 2023-2026
The second-generation Ford Transit Custom and Ford Tourneo Custom, versatile and modern commercial and passenger vans, have been produced from 2023 to the present. Known for their advanced technology, updated design, and improved efficiency, these models continue to be a top choice for businesses and personal transport.

In this article, you will find fuse box diagrams for Ford Transit Custom and Ford Tourneo Custom models produced in 2023, 2024, 2025 and 2026. These diagrams provide essential details about the fuse layout and relay assignments, helping owners and technicians efficiently troubleshoot and maintain the vehicle&#8217;s electrical systems.

What’s Included:

Fuse Box Diagrams: Easy-to-read visuals for quick identification of fuses and relays.

Fuse Panel Locations: Clear instructions on where to find the fuse panels inside the vehicle.

Fuse Assignments: Comprehensive descriptions of each fuse and relay&#8217;s function to simplify diagnostics and repairs.

Whether you are addressing a blown fuse, troubleshooting electrical issues, or performing routine maintenance, this guide is a must-have resource for Ford Transit/Tourneo Custom owners and technicians. It ensures the vehicle’s systems remain in peak operating condition.

Keep your Ford Transit Custom and Ford Tourneo Custom (2023–Present) reliable with this detailed fuse box guide!

The cigar lighter (power outlet) fuses in the Ford Windstar (Freestar) are:

Fuse №57 (2004–2005): Cigar Lighter

Fuse №61 (2004–2005): 3rd-Row Power Point

Fuse №63:

(2004–2005): Instrument Panel Power Point

(2006–2007): Instrument Panel Power Point, Cigar Lighter

Fuse №66:

(2004–2005): 2nd-Row Seat Power Point

(2006–2007): 2nd and 3rd-Row Seat Power Points

All are located in the Engine Compartment Fuse Box

Fuse box location

Passenger compartment

The fuse panel is located below and to the left of the steering wheel by the brake pedal.Remove the panel cover to access the fuses. To remove the fuse panel cover, pull up on the latch on the right or left side of the cover.

Engine compartment

The power distribution box is located in the engine compartment

Auxiliary relay box (cooling fans)

The relay box is located in the engine compartment by the radiator.

#### Ford Windstar (Mk2) | 1999-2003
The second-generation (Mk2) Ford Windstar, a popular minivan known for its spacious interior and family-friendly features, was produced from 1999 to 2003. Designed for comfort and practicality, the Windstar became a go-to choice for families during its production years.

In this article, you will find fuse box diagrams for Ford Windstar models produced between 1999 and 2003, covering years 1999, 2000, 2001, 2002, and 2003. These diagrams provide essential information about the fuse layout and relay assignments, making it easy to troubleshoot and maintain your vehicle’s electrical systems.

What’s Included:

Fuse Box Diagrams: Clear, easy-to-read visuals for quick identification of fuses and relays.

Fuse Panel Locations: Instructions on where to locate the fuse panels inside your Ford Windstar.

Fuse Assignments: A detailed breakdown of each fuse and relay&#8217;s function to simplify diagnostics and repairs.

Whether you&#8217;re dealing with a blown fuse, troubleshooting an electrical issue, or performing routine maintenance, this guide is a valuable resource for Ford Windstar owners and technicians. It ensures you have the information needed to keep your vehicle’s electrical systems operating smoothly.

Keep your Ford Windstar (1999–2003) running reliably with this detailed fuse box guide!

The cigar lighter (power outlet) fuses in the Ford Windstar are:

Fuse No.5 (I/P Power Point; from 2001 onward this becomes the Console Power Point).

Fuse No.15 (from 2001 onward: Console Power Point).

Fuse No.17 (Cigar Lighter/Powerpoint).

All are located in the Instrument Panel Fuse Box.

#### GMC Acadia | 2007-2016
Pre-Facelift

Facelift

Looking for GMC Acadia fuse box information? This guide focuses on the first-generation GMC Acadia, available from 2007 to 2016, and includes fuse box diagrams for GMC Acadia 2007, 2008, 2009, 2010, 2011, 2012, 2013, 2014, 2015 and 2016, plus clear details on fuse panel locations and the assignment of each fuse and relay (fuse layout) to make troubleshooting less mysterious and a lot more straightforward.

Fuse Box Locations

Passenger Compartment

The instrument panel fuse block is located under the instrument panel on the passenger side of the vehicle.

Engine Compartment

The under-hood fuse block is located in the engine compartment, on the passenger side of the vehicle.

Facelift

Fuse Box Locations

Passenger Compartment

The instrument panel fuse block is inside the center console on the passenger side of the vehicle behind the panel.Open the fuse panel door, or remove the panel from the passenger side by pulling it out.

Engine Compartment

The under-hood fuse block is in the engine compartment, on the driver side of the vehicle.

Luggage Compartment

2017-2018

The rear compartment fuse block is behind a trim panel on the driver side of the rear storage compartment.

2019-2023

The rear compartment fuse block is behind a trim panel on the driver side of the rear storage compartment.Remove the side bin, load floor, and foam.

The underhood fuse block on the GMC Acadia is located in the engine compartment on the driver side of the vehicle. To remove the fuse block cover, press the clips on the cover and lift it straight up.

#### GMC Canyon | 2004-2012
Looking for GMC Canyon fuse box diagrams for the original midsize pickup? This article covers the first-generation GMC Canyon, available from 2004 to 2012, and includes clear fuse box diagrams for GMC Canyon 2004, 2005, 2006, 2007, 2008, 2009, 2010, 2011 and 2012, along with accurate fuse panel locations and a detailed breakdown of fuse and relay assignments (fuse layout) to make electrical troubleshooting simple and efficient.

Fuse Box Locations

Engine Compartment

The engine compartment fuse box is located on the passenger side of the engine compartment, near the headlamp.

Accessory Fuse Block

If equipped, the accessory fuse block is also located in the engine compartment, near the main battery and the windshield.

Passenger Compartment

The instrument panel fuse box is located in the passenger compartment on the passenger side, to the right of the footwell beneath the glove compartment.

To access the fuse block, unclip the sides of the trim panel and pull the cover away. The fuse block itself has a cover—press the clips on the sides to remove it and access the fuses.

Fuse Box Locations

Rear Underseat

It is located under the rear seat on the driver’s side of the vehicle (tilt the seat up, remove the fuse box cover).

Engine Compartment

It is located under the hood in the engine compartment on the driver’s side of the vehicle.

Remove the primary cover by pressing the two locking tabs. Remove the secondary cover by snapping off while lifting.

The fuse block is located in the engine compartment on the driver side of the vehicle.

FAQ

			
								
							
						
								
							
			Where are the cigar lighter / power outlet fuses located in GMC Savana, and how do they vary by year?They are all in the engine compartment fuse box, with locations depending on model year:2003–2007: Fuse #29 (Auxiliary Power Outlets) and #30 (Cigarette Lighter)2008–2010: Fuse #33 (Auxiliary Power Outlet) and #38 (Cigarette Lighter)2011 and newer: Fuse #25 (Auxiliary Power Outlet) and #73 (Cigarette Lighter)

Fuse Box Locations

Passenger Compartment

Instrument Panel

The fuse block access door is on the driver’s side edge of the instrument panel.

Center Instrument Panel

The center instrument panel utility block is located underneath the instrument panel, to the left of the steering column.

Engine Compartment

The under-hood fuse block in the engine compartment on the driver’s side of the vehicle near the battery.

Auxiliary Fuse Box

The auxiliary electric cooling fan fuse block is located in the engine compartment on the driver’s side of the vehicle next to the underhood fuse block.

FAQ

			
								
							
						
								
							
			Where are the cigar lighter / power outlet fuses in the GMC Sierra?Engine compartment fuse box:Fuse #55 (2007) or #53 (since 2008) – Cigarette lighter / auxiliary power outletInstrument panel fuse box:Fuse #2 “AUX PWR2” – Rear accessory power outletFuse #16 “AUX PWR” – Accessory power outlets

#### GMC Sierra | 2014-2018
Need fuse box diagrams for the fourth-generation GMC Sierra? This guide covers GMC Sierra 1500, 2500, and 3500 for 2014, 2015, 2016, 2017, and 2018, showing fuse panel locations, clear fuse layouts, and complete fuse and relay assignments—so you can track down the right fuse without playing hide-and-seek under the hood.

Fuse Box Locations

Engine compartment

The engine compartment fuse block is in the engine compartment, on the driver side of the vehicle.

Passenger compartment

Dashboard (Left)

Instrument Panel Fuse Block (Left)The left instrument panel fuse block access door is on the driver side edge of the instrument panel.

Dashboard (Right)

Instrument Panel Fuse Block (Right)The right instrument panel fuse block access door is on the passenger side edge of the instrument panel.

Fuse Box Locations

Passenger Compartment

The instrument panel fuse block is under the instrument panel on the driver side.

To access, press and release the latch near the top center square.

Engine Compartment

The engine compartment fuse box is located on the driver side of the engine compartment.

Luggage Compartment

The rear compartment fuse block is behind a trim panel on the side of the rear compartment. Remove the trim plate to access the fuse block.

#### GMC Yukon | 2007-2014
Explore GMC Yukon fuse box diagrams in this clear guide that outlines the electrical layout of the third-generation full-size SUV. In this article, we consider the third-generation GMC Yukon (also known as Yukon XL), available from 2007 to 2014, and provide fuse box diagrams for GMC Yukon 2007, 2008, 2009, 2010, 2011, 2012, 2013 and 2014, along with information about the location of the fuse panels and the assignment of each fuse and relay (fuse layout).

Fuse Box Locations

Passenger Compartment

The instrument panel fuse block access door is located on the driver side edge of the instrument panel.

Under Dashboard (Center)

The center instrument panel fuse block is located underneath the instrument panel, to the left of the steering column.

Engine Compartment

The Engine Compartment Fuse Block is located in the engine compartment, on the driver side of the vehicle.

#### GMC Yukon | 2015-2020
Explore GMC Yukon fuse box diagrams in this practical guide that explains the electrical layout of the fourth-generation full-size SUV. In this article, we consider the fourth-generation GMC Yukon (also known as Yukon XL), available from 2015 to 2020, and provide fuse box diagrams for GMC Yukon 2015, 2016, 2017, 2018, 2019 and 2020, along with information about the location of the fuse panels and the assignment of each fuse and relay (fuse layout).

Fuse Box Locations

Dashboard (Left)

The left instrument panel fuse block access door is on the driver side edge of the instrument panel.

Dashboard (Right)

The right instrument panel fuse block access door is on the passenger side edge of the instrument panel. There are relays on the back of the fuse block. To access, press the tabs and remove the fuse block.

Engine Compartment

The engine compartment fuse block is in the engine compartment, on the driver side of the vehicle.

Luggage Compartment

The rear compartment fuse block is behind the access panel on the left side of the compartment.

FAQ

			
								
							
						
								
							
			Which fuse controls the cigar lighter (power outlet) in the Honda Accord (2003–2007)?Fuse #9 (Front Accessory Sockets) in the passenger compartment fuse box.

#### Honda Accord | 2008-2012
This guide covers the eighth-generation Honda Accord (2007–2012) (Model Codes: CP1–CP3, CS1–CS2). Here you’ll find fuse box diagrams for Honda Accord 2008, 2009, 2010, 2011 and 2012, along with information about the locations of the fuse panels inside the vehicle and the functions of each fuse (fuse layout).

Fuse box locationsPassenger compartmentEngine compartmentFuse box diagramsPassenger compartmentDriver’s sidePassenger’s sideEngine compartment
Fuse box locations

Passenger compartment

The driver’s side interior fuse box is under the dashboard on the driver’s side.The fuse label is attached to the side panel

The passenger’s side interior fuse box is on the lower passenger’s side panel.

To remove the lid, put your finger in the notch on the lid, and pull it upward slightly, then pull it toward you and take it out of its hinges

Engine compartment

The under-hood fuse box is on the driver’s side.

The primary under-hood fuse box is located on the passenger’s side, near the windshield washer reservoir.

The secondary fuse box is located near the battery.

#### Honda Pilot | 2016-2022
The third-generation Honda Pilot (Model Codes: YF5, YF6) was produced from 2016 to 2022. Known for its spacious three-row seating, advanced safety features, and strong V6 engine, this generation of the Pilot cemented its reputation as a reliable family SUV with a blend of comfort, utility, and performance.

In this article, you will find fuse box diagrams for the Honda Pilot, covering model years 2016, 2017, 2018, 2019, 2020, 2021, and 2022. These diagrams provide a clear overview of the fuse layout, helping you locate and understand the function of each fuse and relay.

Engine compartment

Fuse box location

The Power Distribution Center is located in the engine compartment near the battery. This center contains cartridge fuses, mini-fuses, and relays.A label that identifies each component is printed on the inside of the cover.

#### Jeep Commander | 2006-2010
Explore Jeep Commander fuse box diagrams in this straightforward guide that breaks down the XK model’s electrical layout into something easy to follow. The Jeep Commander (2005–2010) (Model Code: XK) is covered here with fuse diagrams for 2006, 2007, 2008, 2009 and 2010, along with the location of the fuse panels and the assignment of each fuse and relay, giving you a clear understanding of how its systems are powered.

Fuse box locations

Engine compartment

The power distribution unit is located on the left side of the engine compartment.

Fuse Panel &amp; Cover Location

Slowly turn the screw counterclockwise.

Slowly release the screw.

Remove the fuse cover by sliding it upward.

Battery Fuse Cover Location

Passenger compartment

It is located in the passenger compartment on the left side dash panel under the instrument panel.

Luggage compartment

To access the fuses, remove the access door from the left rear panel of the rear cargo area.

The fuses may be contained in two units. Fuse holder version 1 is located closest to the rear of the vehicle and fuse holder version 2 (if equipped with trailer towing) is located closest to the front of the vehicle.

Passenger compartment (Passenger&#8217;s side)

Fuse box location

The Rear Power Distribution Center is located underneath the passenger seat.

How to access it:

First, slide open the HVAC manifold door — slide it from the outside of the vehicle toward the center console.

Using a stubby Phillips screwdriver, remove the single screw (it’s one of those expanding trim-style screws). This step might be optional, but I did it to avoid accidentally damaging anything.

Gently remove the integrated HVAC manifold and floor vent, then set it aside somewhere safe.

From the rear passenger seat, firmly lift the floor cover from the back edge. It’s held in place by two friction clips — one on the rear left and one on the rear right — so a little force is normal.

Now you can unlatch and open the top fuse panel cover.

When you’re done, just reinstall everything by reversing the steps.

Fuse box location

Passenger compartment

The fuse panel is on the left side of the instrument panel behind the cover.A label is attached to the fuse panel cover to identify each fuse for ease of replacement.

Engine compartment

The electrical power distribution center is located in the engine compartment near the battery.

This power center houses plug-in “Cartridge” fuses which replace in-line fusible links. The power center also contains “Mini” fuses and plug-in full and micro ISO relays. A label inside the latching cover of the center identifies each component for ease of replacement, if necessary. “Cartridge” fuses and relays can be obtained from your authorized dealer.

Fuse box locations

Passenger compartment

The fuse panel is on the left side of the instrument panel behind the cover.A label is attached to the fuse panel cover to identify each fuse for ease of replacement.

Engine compartment

The electrical power distribution center is located in the engine compartment near the battery.

This power center houses plug-in “Cartridge” fuses which replace in-line fusible links. The power center also contains “Mini” fuses and plug-in full and micro ISO relays. A label inside the latching cover of the center identifies each component for ease of replacement, if necessary. “Cartridge” fuses and relays can be obtained from your authorized dealer.

Explore Jeep Wagoneer S fuse box diagrams in this quick guide built to help you understand the electrical layout of Jeep’s all-electric crossover. #### Jeep Wrangler | 1997-2006
Explore Jeep Wrangler fuse box diagrams in this straightforward guide made to help you sort out the TJ’s electrical system without the usual confusion. In this article, we focus on the second-generation Jeep Wrangler (1996–2006) (Model Code: TJ) and provide fuse diagrams for 1997, 1998, 1999, 2000, 2001, 2002, 2003, 2004, 2005 and 2006, along with the location of the fuse panels and the assignment of each fuse and relay, giving you the essentials you need in one place.

What’s Included

Fuse box locationsPassenger compartmentEngine compartmentFuse box diagramsPassenger compartmentEngine compartment1997-199819992000-2006FAQ
Fuse box locations

Passenger compartment

The fuse panel is located behind the glove box.

To access the fuse panel, the glove box must be removed. Remove it by slipping the glove box strap off the hook and allowing the door to roll down off its hinges.To reinstall, position the glove box door at an 8 o’clock orientation and engage the hinge hook formations on the lower edge of the glove box door with the hinge pins on the lower edge of the instrument panel. Tilt the upper edge of the glove box door upward toward the instrument panel enough to reattach the glove box strap to the door. Rotate the glove box door to the closed position. Open and close it to ensure proper installation.

Engine compartment

Your vehicle is equipped with an electrical power distribution center located in the engine compartment near the battery.

This power center houses plug-in “Cartridge” fuses, ISO relays, and Mini (Micro) fuses. A label inside the latching cover of the center identifies each component for ease of replacement, if necessary. Cartridge and mini (micro) fuses can be obtained from your authorized dealer.

Passenger Compartment

Fuse Box Location

The fuse box is located behind a lid on the driver’s footwell near the parking brake.

To reach the fuse panel, first move the release lever to the right and carefully pull the trim panel outward. Once the trim panel is removed, press the retaining tabs on both sides of the fuse panel cover and lift the cover away.

When reinstalling, position the upper part of the fuse cover first, then press the lower section until it snaps securely into place. Give the cover a light pull to confirm it is properly locked.

To refit the trim panel, align the lower tabs with the guide slots, press the panel back into position, and slide the release lever to the left to secure it.

Passenger Compartment

Fuse Box Location

The fuse box is located behind a trim panel on the driver’s footwell near the parking brake.

To remove the trim panel:Slide the release lever to the right, then pull the trim panel outward.

To remove the fuse panel cover:Press the tabs on both sides of the cover and pull it off.

To reinstall the fuse panel cover:Place the top part of the cover onto the fuse panel, then press the bottom until it clicks into place. Gently pull on the cover to ensure it is secure.

To reinstall the trim panel:Align the tabs on the bottom of the panel with the grooves, push the panel closed, and slide the release lever to the left to lock it in place.

Engine Compartment (Bottom)

Fuse Box Location

Located on the bottom of the top fuse box.

To access, do the following:

Release the two latches, located on both sides of the fusebox.

Raise the inboard side of the fusebox from the cradle.

Move the fusebox toward the center of the engine compartment.

Pivot the outboard side of the fusebox to access the bottom side.

#### Lincoln Navigator | 2003-2006
Looking for Lincoln Navigator fuse box diagrams? This article covers the second-generation Lincoln Navigator, available from 2003, and includes fuse box diagrams for Lincoln Navigator 2003, 2004, 2005 and 2006, along with details about the location of the fuse panels inside the vehicle and a clear explanation of the assignment of each fuse and relay (fuse layout).

What’s Included
Toggle
Fuse Box LocationFuse Box DiagramFusesRelaysCircuit BreakerFAQ
Fuse Box Location

The Power distribution box is located in the passenger compartment under the right-hand side of the footwell.

To remove the trim panel:Pull the panel toward you, then swing it outward away from the side and remove it.

To reinstall the trim panel:Align the tabs with the grooves on the panel, then push it back into place until secure.

To remove the fuse box cover:Place a finger behind the PULL tab and your thumb above it, then pull the cover off.

To reinstall the cover:Position the top part of the cover on the fuse panel, then press the bottom until it clicks into place. Gently pull on the cover to ensure it is properly seated.

Passenger Compartment

Fuse Box Location

The fuse panel is located in the passenger&#8217;s compartment footwell.

To remove the trim panel:Pull the panel toward you, then swing it outward and remove it.

To reinstall the trim panel:Align the tabs with the grooves, then push the panel back into place until secure.

To remove the fuse box cover:Press the tabs on both sides of the cover and pull it off.

To reinstall the cover:Place the top of the cover onto the fuse panel, then press the bottom until it clicks into place. Gently pull on it to ensure it is properly secured.

To remove the trim panel:Pull the panel toward you, then swing it outward away from the side and remove it.

To reinstall the trim panel:Align the tabs with the grooves on the panel, then push it back into place until secure.

To remove the fuse box cover:Press in the tabs on both sides of the cover, then pull the cover off.

To reinstall the cover:Position the top part of the cover on the fuse panel, then press the bottom until it clicks into place. Gently pull on the cover to ensure it is properly secured.

Fuse Box Location

#### MB A-Class (W168) | 1996-2004
The first-generation Mercedes-Benz A-Class (W168), produced from 1996 to 2004, was a revolutionary model that introduced the brand to the compact car segment. With its innovative &#8220;sandwich floor&#8221; design, it offered enhanced safety and space efficiency in a small footprint. Despite its compact size, the W168 provided surprising versatility, advanced engineering, and the premium feel expected from Mercedes-Benz.

In this article, you will find fuse box diagrams for the Mercedes-Benz A-Class, covering models A140, A160, A170, A190, and A210 for the years 1996 through 2004. These diagrams offer essential insight into the vehicle’s fuse layout, enabling owners and technicians to identify and understand the function of each fuse and relay.

What’s Included:

Fuse Box Diagrams – Detailed, easy-to-read illustrations identifying fuses, relays, and their corresponding systems.

Fuse Panel Locations – Guidance on where the fuse panels are located within the A-Class, including interior and engine compartment positions.

Fuse Assignments – Comprehensive descriptions of what each fuse and relay controls, aiding accurate electrical diagnostics and repairs.

Whether you&#8217;re replacing a faulty fuse, diagnosing an electrical issue, or simply performing preventative maintenance, this guide helps ensure the reliability and safety of your Mercedes-Benz A-Class (W168).

Keep your first-generation A-Class running at its best with this complete fuse box, fuse panel, and relay guide tailored for model years 1996–2004.

The cigar lighter (power outlet) fuse in the Mercedes-Benz A-Class is located in the Passenger Compartment Fuse Box:

fuse №12 (Cigarette Lighter, 12V Socket in Trunk)

#### MB C-Class (W204) | 2008-2014
The third-generation Mercedes-Benz C-Class (W204), produced from 2008 to 2014, brought a refined blend of performance, luxury, and safety. This generation includes models such as the C180, C200, C220, C250, C300, C350, and the high-performance C63 AMG.

In this article, you will find fuse box diagrams for Mercedes-Benz C-Class W204 model years 2008, 2009, 2010, 2011, 2012, 2013, and 2014. This guide also provides detailed fuse layouts, helping you understand the assignment of each fuse and relay across the vehicle’s systems.

Included in This Guide:

Fuse Panel Diagrams – Visual representations showing fuse and relay locations.

Lighting

Climate control

Multimedia

Power windows and seats

Engine and transmission electronics

#### MB E-Class (W210) | 1996-2003
The second-generation Mercedes-Benz E-Class (W210), produced from 1996 to 2003, is a luxury midsize sedan and wagon that set new standards in safety, comfort, and performance. Featuring innovative technology, a variety of engine options, and the distinctive quad-headlight design, the W210 remains a classic and well-regarded model among Mercedes-Benz enthusiasts.

In this article, you will find fuse box diagrams for the Mercedes-Benz E-Class, covering models E200, E220, E230, E240, E250, E270, E280, E290, E300, E320, E420, E36 AMG, E50 AMG, E55 AMG, and E60 AMG for the years 1996, 1997, 1998, 1999, 2000, 2001, 2002, and 2003. #### MB E-Class (W213) | 2017-2023
Explore Mercedes-Benz E-Class fuse box diagrams for 2017–2023 models with fuse locations, panel layouts, and detailed electrical information for all variants. This article covers the fifth-generation Mercedes-Benz E-Class (Model Codes: W213, C238, A238), available from 2017, and includes fuse box diagrams for Mercedes-Benz E180, E200, E250, E300, E350, E400, E450, E43, E53, E63, E200d, E220d, E300d, E350d and E400d (2017, 2018, 2019, 2020, 2021, 2022 and 2023), along with details about the location of the fuse panels inside the vehicle and a clear explanation of the assignment of each fuse (fuse layout).

Engine Compartment

Fuse Box Location

The fuse box is positioned in the engine compartment on the driver’s side beneath the lid. To access it, rotate the clips (2) on the engine cover (1) a quarter turn counterclockwise, then remove the cover in the direction indicated by the arrow. Unscrew the screws (4) and take off the fuse box cover (3).

Fuse Box Location

As one of the longest-running models in Mercedes-Benz history, the W463 has earned a reputation for off-road capability, military-grade toughness, and high-performance AMG variants.

#### MB M-Class (W163) | 1998-2005
The first-generation Mercedes-Benz ML (M-Class; W163), produced from 1998 to 2005, was Mercedes-Benz’s first luxury SUV, combining off-road capability with premium comfort. As one of the pioneers in the luxury SUV segment, the W163 introduced advanced safety features, powerful engine options, and a spacious interior, making it a popular choice for families and adventure seekers alike.

In this article, you will find fuse box diagrams for the Mercedes-Benz M-Class, covering models ML230, ML270, ML320, ML350, ML400, ML430, ML500, and ML55 AMG for the years 1998, 1999, 2000, 2001, 2002, 2003, 2004, and 2005. These diagrams provide crucial insights into the fuse layout, helping vehicle owners, mechanics, and technicians locate and understand the function of each fuse and relay.

What’s Included:

Fuse Box Diagrams – Clear and detailed visuals to help identify fuses, relays, and circuit breakers.

Fuse Panel Locations – Step-by-step guidance on where to find the fuse panels inside the Mercedes-Benz ML-Class.

Fuse Assignments – Comprehensive descriptions of each fuse and relay function for accurate diagnostics and troubleshooting.

Whether you&#8217;re searching for the fuse panel layout, replacing a blown fuse, or diagnosing an electrical issue, this guide is an essential resource. It ensures that your Mercedes-Benz ML-Class’s electrical system remains functional and reliable for daily driving, off-road adventures, and long-distance travel.

Keep your Mercedes-Benz ML-Class (1998–2005) in peak condition with this detailed fuse box, fuse panel, and relay guide!

Passenger compartment

Fuse box location

The Power Distribution Center is located under the driver’s side instrument panel. This center contains cartridge fuses, micro fuses, relays, and circuit breakers.

How to access:

Locate and remove the two screws from the lower portion of the fuse panel cover.

After removing the screws, gently pull both the left and right side of the fuse panel cover to release the fastener clips.

Reverse the procedure to reinstall the fuse panel cover.

#### Toyota 4Runner | 1995-2002
The third-generation Toyota 4Runner (Model Code: N180) was produced from 1995 to 2002. Marking a transition from a compact SUV to a true mid-size utility vehicle, this generation introduced a more refined design, enhanced safety features, and improved on- and off-road performance.

In this article, you will find fuse box diagrams for the Toyota 4Runner, covering model years 1995, 1996, 1997, 1998, 1999, 2000, 2001 and 2002. These diagrams are essential for identifying and servicing the fuses and relays related to critical vehicle systems.

What’s Included:

Fuse Box Diagrams – Year-specific layouts showing fuse and relay positions.

Fuse Panel Locations – Step-by-step guidance to locate each fuse panel.

Fuse Assignments – Full descriptions of the function for each fuse and relay.

Whether you&#8217;re diagnosing an electrical issue or replacing a blown fuse, this reference will help ensure proper maintenance of your Toyota 4Runner (1995–2002).

#### Toyota 86 | 2012-2021
The first-generation Toyota 86—also known as the Toyota GT86—was produced from 2012 to 2021 under model codes ZN6 and ZC6. Developed in collaboration with Subaru (where it&#8217;s known as the BRZ), the 86 is a lightweight rear-wheel-drive sports car praised for its balanced handling, naturally aspirated boxer engine, and pure driving experience.

In this article, you will find fuse box diagrams for the Toyota 86, covering model years 2012, 2013, 2014, 2015, 2016, 2017, 2018, 2019, 2020 and 2021. These diagrams will help you understand the layout of the vehicle’s electrical fuses and relays—essential for diagnostics and basic maintenance.

What’s Included:

Fuse Box Diagrams – Clear illustrations showing the layout of fuses and relays for all covered model years.

Fuse Panel Locations – Guidance on where to find the fuse boxes within the vehicle.

Fuse Assignments – A complete list detailing what each fuse and relay controls to aid in troubleshooting.

Whether you&#8217;re replacing a blown fuse or diagnosing an electrical issue, this guide will support your maintenance work on the Toyota 86 / GT86 (2012–2021) efficiently and accurately.

FAQ

			
								
							
						
								
							
			Which fuses control the cigar lighter (power outlet) in the Toyota 86 / GT86?

The fuses are #1 “P/POINT NO.1” and #38 “P/POINT NO.2” in the Instrument panel fuse box.

The first-generation Toyota Aurion was produced from 2006 to 2012 under the model code XV40. Positioned as a premium mid-size sedan, it was developed primarily for markets such as Australia and New Zealand and offered refined styling, strong V6 performance, and a well-appointed interior.

FAQ

			
								
							
						
								
							
			Which fuses control the cigar lighter (power outlet) in the Toyota Auris?

The fuses are #1 “P/OUTLET” (Power outlet) and #17 “CIG” (Cigarette lighter) in the Instrument panel fuse box.

The first-generation Toyota Auris Hybrid—also known as the Auris HSD—was produced from 2009 to 2013 under the model code E150. As Toyota’s first compact hatchback to incorporate hybrid technology, it delivered a quiet, efficient, and environmentally friendly driving experience while retaining the practicality and comfort of the standard Auris.

#### Toyota Avensis Verso / Ipsum / Picnic | 2001-2010
The second-generation Toyota Avensis Verso, also known in various markets as the Toyota Ipsum or Toyota Picnic, was produced from 2001 to 2010 under the model code XM20. This mid-size MPV was designed to offer family-friendly versatility, spacious seating for up to seven passengers, and Toyota’s hallmark reliability.

In this article, you will find fuse box diagrams for the Toyota Avensis Verso / Ipsum / Picnic, covering model years 2001, 2002, 2003, 2004, 2005, 2006, 2007, 2008, 2009 and 2010. These diagrams are essential for identifying fuses and relays linked to various electrical systems in the vehicle.

What’s Included:

Fuse Box Diagrams – Visual representations showing the layout of fuses and relays.

Fuse Panel Locations – Guidance on where to locate fuse boxes within the vehicle.

Fuse Assignments – A detailed breakdown of what each fuse and relay controls.

Whether you&#8217;re replacing a blown fuse or troubleshooting an electrical issue, this guide will help you service and maintain your Toyota Avensis Verso / Ipsum / Picnic (2001–2010) with confidence.

FAQ

			
								
							
						
								
							
			What fuses control the cigar lighter (power outlet) in the Toyota Avensis Verso / Ipsum / Picnic?

The fuses are:#9 “C/LTR” or “CIG” – Cigarette lighter#15 “PWR OUTLET” – Power outlet#12 “AC INV” (Ipsum only) – Power outlet (inverter)
All are located in the Instrument panel fuse box.

#### Toyota Aygo | 2005-2014
The first-generation Toyota Aygo (Model Code: AB10) was produced from 2005 to 2014. Developed as part of a joint venture with Citroën and Peugeot, the Aygo shared its platform with the C1 and 107, offering a practical, efficient, and compact solution for urban driving.

FAQ

			
								
							
						
								
							
			Which fuses control the cigar lighter and power outlet in the Toyota Corolla?

The fuses are #24 “CIG” (Cigarette Lighter) and #4 “ACC-B” (CIG, ACC) in the Instrument panel fuse box.

#### Toyota Corolla | 2013-2019
The eleventh-generation Toyota Corolla (Model Codes: E160 / E170 / E180) was produced from 2013 to 2019. This generation featured significant updates in styling, safety, and fuel efficiency, making it one of the most popular and reliable compact sedans globally.

In this article, you will find fuse box diagrams for the Toyota Corolla, covering model years 2013, 2014, 2015, 2016, 2017, 2018 and 2019. These diagrams will help you locate the correct fuses and relays associated with your vehicle’s electrical systems.

What’s Included:

Fuse Box Diagrams – Visual layouts of fuse and relay positions.

Fuse Panel Locations – Instructions on where to find fuse panels inside the vehicle.

Fuse Assignments – Detailed information on what each fuse and relay controls.

Whether you&#8217;re diagnosing an electrical problem or replacing a blown fuse, this guide will help you service and maintain the Toyota Corolla (2013–2019) with confidence.

FAQ

			
								
							
						
								
							
			Which fuses control the cigar lighter and power outlet in the Toyota Corolla?

The fuses are #1 “P/OUTLET” (Power outlet) and #17 “CIG” (Cigarette Lighter) in the Instrument panel fuse box.

#### Toyota Corolla Verso | 2004-2010
The third-generation Toyota Corolla Verso (Model Code: AR10) was produced from 2004 to 2010. Designed as a compact MPV, it combined the practicality of a minivan with the driving dynamics of a hatchback, making it a popular choice for families in need of flexible space and comfort.

In this article, you will find fuse box diagrams for the Toyota Corolla Verso, covering model years 2004, 2005, 2006, 2007, 2008, 2009 and 2010. These diagrams are crucial for identifying, inspecting, or replacing the correct fuses and relays related to various electrical systems in the vehicle.

What’s Included:

Fuse Box Diagrams – Detailed layouts showing the location and function of fuses and relays.

Fuse Panel Locations – Instructions on where to find fuse boxes inside the car.

Fuse Assignments – An itemized list of what each fuse and relay controls.

Whether you&#8217;re fixing a non-functional accessory or diagnosing an electrical issue, this guide will help you efficiently service your Toyota Corolla Verso (2004–2010).

FAQ

			
								
							
						
								
							
			What fuses control the cigar lighter and power outlet in the Toyota Corolla Verso?

The fuses are #9 “CIG” (Cigarette Lighter) and #16 “P/POINT” (Power Outlet) in the Passenger Compartment Fuse box.
