FAQ

			
								
							
						
								
							
			Which fuses control the cigar lighter and power outlets in the Toyota Highlander?

The fuses controlling the cigar lighter and power outlets in the Toyota Highlander are:
Fuse #3 “CIG” – for the cigarette lighterFuse #5 “PWR OUTLET1” – for the power outlets
Both are located in the instrument panel fuse box.

#### Toyota Highlander | 2007-2013
The second-generation Toyota Highlander—also marketed as the Toyota Kluger in Australia—was produced from 2007 to 2013 under the model code XU40. Built on a unibody platform shared with the Camry, this generation offered increased size, comfort, and versatility compared to its predecessor, making it a popular choice for families and commuters alike.

FAQ

			
								
							
						
								
							
			Where are the cigar lighter (power outlet) fuses located in the Toyota Highlander?

They are fuses #28 “ACC SOCK NO.1” and #29 “ACC SOCK NO.2” in the Instrument panel fuse box.

#### Toyota Highlander Hybrid | 2005-2007
The first-generation Toyota Highlander Hybrid—also known as the Toyota Kluger Hybrid in Australia—was produced from 2005 to 2007 under the model code MHU28. As Toyota&#8217;s first mid-size SUV to feature hybrid technology, it combined the spaciousness and versatility of a crossover with the fuel efficiency of a hybrid powertrain, setting a new standard for eco-friendly family vehicles.

In this article, you will find fuse box diagrams for the Toyota Highlander Hybrid, covering model years 2005, 2006, and 2007. These diagrams are essential for understanding the fuse layout, helping you locate, inspect, or replace fuses and relays related to key electrical systems.

FAQ

			
								
							
						
								
							
			Which fuses control the cigar lighter (power outlet) in the Toyota Hilux?

Fuses #5 “PWR OUT” and #9 “CIG” in the Instrument panel fuse box.

#### Toyota Hilux | 2015-2025
The eighth-generation Toyota Hilux (Model Codes: AN110/AN120/AN130), available from 2015 to 2025, continues the legacy of durability, reliability, and versatility that has defined the Hilux nameplate for decades. Renowned for its rugged off-road capabilities and dependability in harsh conditions, this generation offers modernized styling, updated technology, and improved comfort while maintaining its workhorse reputation.

In this article, you will find fuse box diagrams for the Toyota Hilux, covering model years 2015, 2016, 2017, 2018, 2019, 2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024, and 2025. These diagrams are an essential reference for identifying and understanding the electrical components and their respective fuses and relays.

What’s Included:

Fuse Box Diagrams – Clear visual layouts that map out the position and labeling of all fuses and relays.

Fuse Panel Locations – Detailed guidance on where to locate the fuse boxes inside the cabin and engine compartment.

Fuse Assignments – Complete listings of each fuse and relay function to aid in troubleshooting and maintenance.

Whether you&#8217;re replacing a blown fuse, diagnosing an electrical issue, or installing aftermarket accessories, this guide will help ensure your Toyota Hilux (2015–2025) remains reliable and fully functional in any condition.

FAQ

			
								
							
						
								
							
			Which fuses protect the cigar lighter and power outlet in the Toyota Land Cruiser Prado?

In the Toyota Land Cruiser Prado, the relevant fuses in the Instrument Panel Fuse Box are:
Fuse #12 “PWR OUTLET” – for the 12 V auxiliary power outletFuse #24 “CIG” – for the cigar lighter socket
If either the cigar lighter or outlet stops working, check these fuses and replace any that are blown with the correct amp rating.

FAQ

			
								
							
						
								
							
			Which fuses protect the cigar lighter and power outlets in the Toyota Matrix?

In the Toyota Matrix, the relevant fuses (in the Instrument Panel Fuse Box) are:
#28 “INV” – 115 V AC power outlet (inverter)#29 “P/POINT” – rear-console 12 V power outlet#31 “CIG” – instrument-panel 12 V cigar lighter/output
Check and replace with correct amperage if any outlet stops working!

FAQ

			
								
							
						
								
							
			Which fuses control the cigar lighter and power outlet in the Toyota Matrix?

The fuses are #7 “CIG” and #22 “ACC-B” in the Instrument panel fuse box, and #37 “PWR OUTLET/INVERTER” in the Engine compartment fuse box.

FAQ

			
								
							
						
								
							
			Which fuse controls the cigar lighter (power outlet) in the Toyota Paseo?

In the Toyota Paseo, the cigar lighter (12 V power outlet) is protected by fuse #21, labeled “CIG &amp; RADIO”, located in the Instrument Panel Fuse Box.
If your cigarette socket stops working, check this fuse and replace it with the correct rating as specified in your owner’s manual.

#### Toyota Prius | 2000-2003
The first-generation Toyota Prius (NHW11), produced from 2000 to 2003 following a facelift, was the pioneering mass-produced hybrid vehicle that helped redefine fuel efficiency and eco-friendly driving. This innovative model combined a gasoline engine with an electric motor in a compact sedan form, setting the stage for Toyota’s hybrid success worldwide.

In this article, you will find fuse box diagrams for the Toyota Prius, covering model years 2000, 2001, 2002, and 2003. These diagrams are essential for anyone looking to understand, locate, or troubleshoot the vehicle’s electrical system.

What’s Included:

Fuse Box Diagrams – Accurate visual guides to help identify each fuse and relay.

Fuse Panel Locations – Step-by-step details on where to locate the fuse panels in your Prius.

Fuse Assignments – Full descriptions of each fuse and relay function, aiding in diagnostics and component replacement.

Whether you’re replacing a blown fuse or diagnosing an electrical issue, this reference ensures you can maintain and repair your Toyota Prius (2000–2003) with confidence and precision.

FAQ

			
								
							
						
								
							
			Which fuse protects the cigar lighter (power outlet) in the Toyota Prius?

In the Toyota Prius, the 12 V cigar lighter (power outlet) is safeguarded by Fuse #10, labeled “CIG”, located in the Instrument Panel Fuse Box.If the cigarette lighter stops working, check Fuse #10 first and replace it with the same amperage rating specified in your owner’s manual.

FAQ

			
								
							
						
								
							
			Which fuses protect the cigar lighter (power outlet) in the Toyota Prius (2003–2009)?

In the second-generation Toyota Prius (2003–2009), the relevant fuses in the Instrument Panel Fuse Box are:
Fuse #12 “ACC‑B” – protects the accessory circuit, including power outletsFuse #23 “PWR OUTLET” – safeguards interior 12 V accessory socketsFuse #29 “PWR OUTLET FR” – dedicated to the front power outlet (cigarette lighter)
These are 15 A mini fuses located beneath the driver’s side dash. For blown fuse issues, Prius owners often report checking these three fuses first and replacing them with exact-match types

FAQ

			
								
							
						
								
							
			Which fuses protect the cigar lighter and power outlet in the Toyota Prius?

In the Toyota Prius, the interior cigar lighter and auxiliary power outlet are protected by two fuses located in the Instrument Panel Fuse Box:
Fuse #1, labeled “CIG” – serves the cigar lighter (cigarette socket).Fuse #3, labeled “PWR OUTLET” – covers the 12 V auxiliary power outlet.
If the cigarette lighter or power outlet stops working, inspect these fuses and replace any blown fuse with the correct amperage rating indicated in your owner’s manual.

FAQ

			
								
							
						
								
							
			Which fuses protect the cigar lighter (power outlet) in the Toyota Prius?

In the Toyota Prius, the following fuses cover the interior 12 V power outlets:
Fuse #1, labeled “P/OUTLET NO. 1”, located in the Instrument Panel Fuse Box, covers the primary front accessory power socket (often used for mobile chargers).Fuse #2, labeled “P/OUTLET NO. 2”, found in the Engine Compartment Fuse Box, protects a secondary auxiliary power outlet if equipped (usually for rear or cargo-mounted sockets).
If either power outlet stops working, check the corresponding fuse and replace it with the same amperage rating.

#### Toyota Prius | 2022-2026
The fifth-generation Toyota Prius (Model Code: XW60), available from 2022 to the present, represents a bold redesign of Toyota’s iconic hybrid. This generation introduces a sportier aesthetic, advanced hybrid powertrain technology, and a suite of modern driver-assistance features, all while maintaining the fuel efficiency and eco-conscious engineering the Prius is known for.

In this article, you will find fuse box diagrams for the Toyota Prius, covering model years 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025 and 2026. These diagrams are essential for understanding the vehicle&#8217;s electrical system, whether you&#8217;re troubleshooting issues or performing maintenance.

Fuse box location

FAQ

			
								
							
						
								
							
			Which fuse protects the cigar lighter (power outlet) in the Toyota Prius C?

In the Toyota Prius C, the cigar lighter / 12 V power outlet is safeguarded by Fuse #15, labeled “CIG”, located in the Instrument Panel Fuse Box.If the outlet stops working, start by checking Fuse #15 and replace it with the same amperage rating if blown.

FAQ

			
								
							
						
								
							
			Which fuses control the cigar lighter and power outlet in the Toyota Prius V / Prius+ / Prius α?

In the Toyota Prius V, Prius+, or Prius α, the interior cigar lighter and accessory power outlets are protected by two fuses located in the Instrument Panel Fuse Box:
Fuse #1 “CIG” – dedicated to the cigar lighter (cigarette socket).Fuse #3 “PWR OUTLET” – protects the 12 V auxiliary power outlet.
If the lighter or outlet stops working, inspect these fuses first and replace any blown fuse with the same amperage specified in your owner’s manual.

FAQ

			
								
							
						
								
							
			Which fuse protects the cigarette lighter (power outlet) in the Toyota RAV4?

In the Toyota RAV4, the primary cigar lighter (12 V power outlet) is protected by:Fuse #4 “CIG &amp; RAD” located in Instrument Panel Fuse Box #1. This fuse supplies power to both the cigar lighter and the radio circuits.
Additionally, some models include:Fuse “AM1” in Passenger Compartment Fuse Box #2, which provides auxiliary power for related systems.
If the cigar lighter or radio stops functioning, check fuse #4 first. For broader power issues, the AM1 fuse may be involved as well—refer to your owner&#8217;s manual to verify the exact layout and wattage ratings.

FAQ

			
								
							
						
								
							
			Which fuses protect the cigar lighter and power outlets in the Toyota RAV4?

In the Toyota RAV4, both the cigarette lighter and auxiliary power outlets within the cabin are safeguarded by two fuses housed in the Instrument Panel Fuse Box:
Fuse #15 “PWR OUTLET” — Powers the 12 V auxiliary power outlet (power socket).Fuse #16 “CIG” — Dedicated to the cigar lighter (cigarette socket).
If either the power outlet or lighter stops working, check these two fuses first and replace with the correct amperage rating.

FAQ

			
								
							
						
								
							
			Which fuses protect the cigar lighter and power outlets in the Toyota RAV4?

In the Toyota RAV4, the following fuses in the Instrument Panel Fuse Box are responsible for the cigarette lighter and auxiliary power outlets:
Fuse #2 “CIG” — Powers the cigarette lighter (cigar lighter).Fuse #3 “POWER OUTLET” — Protects the 12 V auxiliary power outlets (power ports).
Check these fuses if your vehicle&#8217;s lighter or power outlets stop working, and replace any blown fuse with the correct amperage as specified in the manufacturer’s guide.

FAQ

			
								
							
						
								
							
			Which fuses control the cigar lighter and power outlets in the Toyota RAV4?

In the Toyota RAV4, several fuses provide power to the 12 V outlets, cigar lighter, and optional inverter. These are located in two fuse boxes:
Instrument Panel Fuse Box:Fuse #23 “CIG” — Cigarette LighterFuse #24 “ACC” — Accessory Power OutletsFuse #27 “PWR OUTLET” — Power OutletsFuse #12 “ACC‑B” — Accessory circuit (shared with lighter/outlets)
Engine Compartment Fuse Box (Fuse Box №1):Fuse #18 “AC INV” — Controls the 115 V AC power outlet (inverter-powered, if equipped)
If the front 12 V socket, auxiliary outlets, or inverter outlet are not functioning, consult this list. Always replace any blown fuse with one of the exact amperage rating as listed in your owner’s manual. Let me know if you&#8217;d like amperage details or a user manual diagram!

#### Toyota RAV4 | 2013-2018
The fourth-generation Toyota RAV4 (Model Code: XA40), produced from 2012 to 2018, brought a refined and more aerodynamic design, improved handling, and increased cargo space. This generation also marked the departure from the rear-mounted spare tire and introduced more advanced safety and infotainment features, making it a popular choice among compact SUV buyers.

In this article, you will find fuse box diagrams for the Toyota RAV4, covering model years 2012, 2013, 2014, 2015, 2016, 2017, and 2018. These diagrams are essential for identifying fuse and relay functions within the vehicle’s electrical system.

What’s Included:

Fuse Box Diagrams – Accurate and clear visuals displaying fuse and relay positions.

Fuse Panel Locations – Guidance on where to find the fuse boxes inside the cabin and engine compartment.

Fuse Assignments – Detailed descriptions of each fuse and relay, helping with electrical diagnostics and repairs.

Whether you&#8217;re troubleshooting an electrical issue, replacing a blown fuse, or performing maintenance, this guide will help you keep your Toyota RAV4 (2012–2018) running smoothly and reliably.

FAQ

			
								
							
						
								
							
			Which fuses protect the cigar lighter (power outlet) in the Toyota RAV4?

In the Toyota RAV4, the following fuses in the Instrument Panel Fuse Box control the 12 V accessory power outlets:
Fuse #9 “P/OUTLET NO.1” – powers the primary front power outlet / cigarette lighterFuse #18 “P/OUTLET NO.2” – powers the secondary accessory power outlet, if equipped
Both fuses are typically found under the dashboard, driver’s side. If your power outlets or cigar lighter stop working, check these fuses and replace them with the correct amperage as specified in your owner’s manual.

FAQ

			
								
							
						
								
							
			Which fuses protect the cigar lighter and power outlets in the Toyota Sequoia?

The fuse layout varies by generation:Model Years 2000–2002 (Instrument Panel Fuse Box):Fuse #31 “CIG” — Cigarette LighterFuse #45 “PWR OUTLET” — Accessory Power Outlets (12 V)Fuse #53 “AM1” — Accessory/Main circuit
Model Years 2003–2007 (Instrument Panel Fuse Box):Fuse #38 “AC INV” — 115 V AC inverter outletFuse #42 “CIG” — Cigarette LighterFuse #55 “PWR OUTLET” — Accessory Power Outlets (12 V)
Check and replace these fuses with the correct amperage specified in your owner’s manual if you experience issues with any power outlet or the cigarette lighter.

FAQ

			
								
							
						
								
							
			Which fuses control the cigar lighter (power outlet) in the Toyota Sequoia?

In the Toyota Sequoia, the following fuses in the Instrument Panel Fuse Box protect the cigarette lighter and accessory power outlets:
Fuse #1 “INVERTER” – Protects the 115 V/120 V inverter power outlet (if equipped)Fuse #6 “PWR OUTLET” – Covers the standard 12 V accessory power outletsFuse #31 “CIG” – Dedicated to the cigarette lighter (cigar lighter)
Each fuse is clearly labeled on the fuse box cover; check and replace any blown fuse with the same amperage rating.

#### Toyota Sienna | 1997-2003
The first-generation Toyota Sienna (Model Code: XL10), produced from 1997 to 2003, marked Toyota’s entry into the North American minivan market with a front-wheel-drive platform based on the Camry. Known for its smooth ride, reliability, and efficient V6 engine, the XL10 Sienna became a practical and family-friendly option, earning a reputation for long-term dependability.

In this article, you will find fuse box diagrams for the Toyota Sienna, covering model years 1997, 1998, 1999, 2000, 2001, 2002, and 2003. These diagrams offer crucial information for identifying and understanding the location and function of each fuse and relay.

FAQ

			
								
							
						
								
							
			Which fuses control the cigar lighter and power outlet in the Toyota Sienna?

In the Toyota Sienna, the 12 V auxiliary power system is covered by two fuses located in the Instrument Panel Fuse Box:
Fuse labeled “PWR‑OUTLET” – protects the auxiliary power outlet (12 V power socket)Fuse labeled “CIG” – dedicated to the cigar lighter / cigarette socket
If your front power socket or cigar lighter stops working, check these fuses first and replace them if they are blown using the correct amp rating specified in your vehicle’s manual.

FAQ

			
								
							
						
								
							
			Which fuses control the cigar lighter and power outlets in the Toyota Sienna?

In the Toyota Sienna, multiple fuse circuits handle the standard cigar lighter outlet, auxiliary power sockets, and optional AC inverter. All are located in the Instrument Panel Fuse Box:
Fuse #3 “PWR OUTLET” – Protects the regular 12 V accessory power outlets (power points)Fuse #4 “CIG” – Dedicated to the cigar lighter / cigarette lighter socketFuse #21 “AC INV” – For 115 V AC power outlets (when equipped with an inverter)
Check these fuses if interior power outlets or the lighter stop functioning, and replace any blown fuse with the correct amp rating as specified in the owner’s manual. Let me know if you&#8217;d like the exact amperage or fuse location details!

FAQ

			
								
							
						
								
							
			Which fuses protect the cigar lighter (12 V power outlet) in the Toyota Sienna?

In the Toyota Sienna, these functions are protected by two fuses residing in the Instrument Panel Fuse Box:
Fuse #1 labeled “P/OUTLET” — powers the 12 V accessory power outlet (often referred to as the power point).Fuse #4 labeled “CIG” — dedicated to the cigar lighter / cigarette socket.
Both fuses are located in the dashboard fuse block. If your power socket or lighter is not working, be sure to check these fuses and replace them if needed, using the correct amperage rating.

FAQ

			
								
							
						
								
							
			Which fuses control the cigar lighter and power outlet in the Toyota Solara?

In the Toyota Solara, the cigar lighter and power outlet are protected by the following fuses located in the Instrument Panel Fuse Box:
Fuse #30 – Power outletFuse #38 – Cigarette lighter
If either the lighter or power socket is not functioning, check these fuses and replace any that are blown using the correct amperage rating.

			Which fuses protect the cigar lighter (power outlet) in the Toyota Solara?

In the Toyota Solara, the 12 V cigar lighter and accessory power socket circuits are safeguarded by two fuses in the Instrument Panel Fuse Box:
Fuse #44 “CIG” — for the cigar lighter / cigarette socketFuse #45 “P/POINT” — for the 12 V power outlet / auxiliary socket
These fuses are typically located within the dashboard&#8217;s fuse box—refer to your owner&#8217;s manual or the fuse cover for the precise layout.

#### Toyota Tacoma | 1995-2000
The first-generation Toyota Tacoma (Model codes: N140, N150, N160, N170, N190) was introduced in 1995 and remained in its pre-facelift form until 2000. Designed as a compact pickup truck with an emphasis on ride comfort and improved safety over its predecessor, the Toyota Pickup (Hilux in some markets), this generation marked a major shift toward a more car-like driving experience. It was available in multiple configurations, including Regular Cab, Xtracab, and PreRunner models.

In this article, you will find fuse box diagrams for the Toyota Tacoma, covering model years 1995, 1996, 1997, 1998, 1999, and 2000. These diagrams are essential for identifying and understanding the function of each fuse and relay in your vehicle’s electrical system.

What’s Included:

Fuse Box Diagrams – Detailed layouts of the fuse boxes to help you locate and identify each fuse and relay.

Fuse Panel Locations – Information on where to find the main fuse panels inside the cabin and under the hood.

Fuse Assignments – Full descriptions of each fuse and relay’s purpose, aiding in diagnostics and electrical troubleshooting.

Whether you&#8217;re replacing a blown fuse or resolving a power issue, this guide is a valuable resource for keeping your Toyota Tacoma (1995–2000) running smoothly and reliably.

FAQ

			
								
							
						
								
							
			What are the cigar lighter (power outlet) fuses for the Toyota Tacoma (1995–2000)?

The fuse locations for the cigar lighter and power outlet in the Toyota Tacoma vary by year:
1995–1997:Fuse #25 “CIG” in the Instrument Panel Fuse Box (controls the cigarette lighter).
1998–2000:Fuse #26 “CIG” in the Instrument Panel Fuse Box (cigarette lighter), andFuse #1 “PWR OUTLET” in the Engine Compartment Fuse Box (auxiliary power outlet).
If your lighter or outlet is not working, check these fuses first and replace any that are blown using the correct amperage.

FAQ

			
								
							
						
								
							
			Which fuses control the cigar lighter (power outlet) in the Toyota Tacoma?

In the Toyota Tacoma, the cigar lighter and auxiliary power outlet circuits are protected by:
Fuse #2 “ACC” — Cigarette Lighter (12 V accessory outlet), located in the Instrument Panel Fuse BoxFuse #19 “PWR OUTLET” — Auxiliary Power Outlet, located in the Engine Compartment Fuse Box
These fuses are essential for powering the front interior 12 V socket and any additional powered outlets installed in the vehicle.

#### Toyota Tacoma | 2005-2015
The second-generation Toyota Tacoma (Model codes: N220, N240, N250, N260, N270) was produced from 2005 to 2015, offering a robust and versatile mid-size pickup truck designed for both off-road capability and daily utility. This generation featured updated styling, enhanced safety, and a variety of cab and engine configurations, making it a popular choice among truck enthusiasts and professionals alike.

In this article, you will find fuse box diagrams for the Toyota Tacoma, covering model years 2005, 2006, 2007, 2008, 2009, 2010, 2011, 2012, 2013, 2014, and 2015. These diagrams will help you locate and identify fuses and relays essential to your vehicle’s electrical functions.

FAQ

			
								
							
						
								
							
			Which fuses protect the cigar lighter and power outlets in the Toyota Tundra (2007–2010)?

In the Toyota Tundra from 2007 to 2010, the following fuses located in the Instrument Panel Fuse Box control the cigar lighter and accessory power outlets:
Fuse #1 “INVERTER” – related to optional inverter-equipped outlets.Fuse #5 “PWR OUTLET” – powers the standard 12 V auxiliary power socket.Fuse #27 “CIG” – dedicated to the cigar lighter outlet.
Ensure proper fuse removal and replacement to maintain safe and functional accessory power.

FAQ

			
								
							
						
								
							
			Which fuses control the cigar lighter (power outlet) in the Toyota Tundra Double Cab?

In the Toyota Tundra Double Cab, the following fuses located in the Instrument Panel Fuse Box are responsible for powering the cigar lighter and auxiliary outlets:
Fuse #4 “AC INV” – handles the AC inverter circuit (if your model has an inverter-equipped outlet)Fuse #8 “CIG” – dedicated to the cigar lighter (12 V socket)Fuse #22 “PWR OUTLET” – covers the auxiliary power outlet / front power point
These fuses ensure proper operation of in-cabin power sockets and require attention if any accessory power stops functioning.

FAQ

			
								
							
						
								
							
			Which fuses control the cigar lighter (power outlet) in the Toyota Tundra &#8220;Regular Cab&#8221; and &#8220;Access Cab&#8221;?

In the Toyota Tundra &#8220;Regular Cab&#8221; and &#8220;Access Cab&#8221; trims:
Instrument Panel Fuse Box:Fuse labeled &#8220;ACC&#8221; – this fuse is dedicated to the cigarette lighter (cigar lighter).
Engine Compartment Fuse Box:Fuse labeled &#8220;PWR OUTLET 1&#8221; – powers the upper auxiliary power outlet.Fuse labeled &#8220;PWR OUTLET 2&#8221; – powers the lower auxiliary power outlet.
These fuses cover the in-cabin cigarette lighter socket and two separate auxiliary power outlets for accessories.

FAQ

			
								
							
						
								
							
			Which fuses protect the cigar lighter and power outlets in the Toyota Venza?

In the Toyota Venza, the relevant fuses are:
Instrument Panel Fuse Box:Fuse #30 “PWR OUTLET NO.1” – associated with the cigar lighter / front accessory power outlet
Engine Compartment Fuse Box:Fuse #33 “AC 115V” – controls the 115 V AC power outlet, if equipped (commonly used for inverters or higher‑voltage accessories)
These fuses cover both the standard 12 V socket and the optional AC power outlet in the vehicle.

#### Toyota Verso | 2009-2018
The Toyota Verso (Model Code: AR20) is a compact MPV that was produced from 2009 to 2018, offering a combination of family-friendly practicality, versatility, and Toyota’s reputation for reliability. With seating for up to seven passengers, the Verso was designed to be a smart solution for growing families and urban commuters alike.

In this article, you will find fuse box diagrams for the Toyota Verso, covering model years 2009, 2010, 2011, 2012, 2013, 2014, 2015, 2016, 2017, and 2018. These diagrams are essential for locating and identifying the function of each fuse and relay in your vehicle.

What’s Included:

Fuse Box Diagrams – Accurate, easy-to-read diagrams showing the layout of all fuses and relays.

Fuse Panel Locations – Clear guidance on where to find the interior and engine compartment fuse panels.

Fuse Assignments – A detailed description of each fuse and relay’s purpose, aiding in diagnostics and repairs.

Whether you&#8217;re troubleshooting an electrical issue, replacing a blown fuse, or performing regular maintenance, this guide provides the information you need to keep your Toyota Verso (2009–2018) in top working condition.

FAQ

			
								
							
						
								
							
			Which fuses control the cigar lighter and power outlets in the Toyota Verso?

In the Toyota Verso, the cigar lighter and 12 V power outlets are protected by the following fuses:
Instrument Panel Fuse Box:Fuse #4 “ACC‑B” – powers both the cigarette lighter (“CIG”) and auxiliary power outlet (“ACC”) circuitsFuse #24 “CIG” – specifically for the cigarette lighter
Engine Compartment Fuse Box:Fuse #50 “PWR OUTLET” – powers the auxiliary power outlet (12 V socket) located in the engine bay area or onboard accessories
These fuses are essential for powering the interior cigarette lighter and any auxiliary sockets in the vehicle.

			Which fuse protects the cigar lighter (power outlet) in the Toyota Verso‑S / Ractis / Space Verso?

In the Toyota Verso‑S, Ractis, and Space Verso, the cigar lighter (12 V power outlet) is protected by fuse №23, labeled “CIG”, located in the Instrument Panel Fuse Box.

FAQ

			
								
							
						
								
							
			Which fuse protects the cigar lighter (power outlet) in the Toyota Yaris / Vitz / Belta?

In the Toyota Yaris, Vitz, or Belta, the cigar lighter (12 V power outlet) is safeguarded by fuse #8, labeled “CIG”, located in the Instrument Panel Fuse Box.

#### Toyota Yaris / Echo / Vitz / Platz | 1999-2006
The first-generation Toyota Yaris (also marketed as the Echo, Vitz, or Platz depending on region, Model Code: XP10) was produced from 1999 to 2006. This pioneering model introduced Toyota’s subcompact to a global audience, praised for its efficient use of space, reliability, and fuel economy. Its quirky, youthful design and practicality made it especially popular among urban drivers and first-time car owners.

In this article, you will find fuse box diagrams for the Toyota Yaris, covering model years 1999, 2000, 2001, 2002, 2003, 2004, 2005, and 2006. FAQ

			
								
							
						
								
							
			Which fuses protect the cigar lighter (power outlet) in the Toyota Yaris / Echo / Vitz?

In the Toyota Yaris, Echo, or Vitz, the cigar lighter and power outlets are protected by two fuses located in the Instrument Panel Fuse Box:Fuse #9, labeled “ACC”, for the cigarette lighter (cigar lighter functionality)Fuse #9, labeled “P/POINT”, for the auxiliary power outlet (12V accessory socket)Both fuses share the same position but are used for slightly different power functions.

#### Toyota Yaris / Echo / Vitz | 2012-2019
The third-generation Toyota Yaris (also marketed in various regions as the Echo or Vitz, Model Code: XP130) was produced from 2012 to 2019. This generation introduced a more modern design, improved interior quality, and enhanced safety features, making it a standout in the subcompact car segment. With both petrol and hybrid variants, the XP130 offered versatility, efficiency, and practicality for urban and daily use.

FAQ

			
								
							
						
								
							
			What are the cigar lighter (power outlet) fuses in the Volvo S60?

Fuse #22 (12V sockets) in fuse box “A” under the glove compartment, and fuse #7 (rear 12V socket) in the luggage compartment fuse box.

#### Volvo S60 | 2015-2018
The second-generation Volvo S60, after receiving its facelift in 2015, was produced until 2018. This update refreshed Volvo’s premium compact executive sedan with sharper styling, upgraded interiors, improved safety features, and more efficient engines. The facelift brought the S60 closer to Volvo’s evolving design language while maintaining its reputation for comfort, performance, and cutting-edge safety technology.

In this article, you will find fuse box diagrams for the Volvo S60, covering model years 2015, 2016, 2017 and 2018. These diagrams help you understand the fuse layout, making it easier to locate, inspect, and replace fuses and relays tied to vital electrical systems.

What’s Included:

Fuse Box Diagrams – Clear illustrations showing the arrangement of fuses and relays.

Fuse Panel Locations – Step-by-step details on where to find fuse panels inside the vehicle.

Fuse Assignments – A full breakdown of each fuse and relay function to simplify troubleshooting and repairs.

Whether you’re replacing a blown fuse, diagnosing an electrical problem, or performing preventative maintenance, this guide will help keep your Volvo S60 (2015–2018) operating at peak reliability and safety.

FAQ

			
								
							
						
								
							
			What are the cigar lighter (power outlet) fuses in the Volvo S60?

Fuse #22 (tunnel console sockets) in fuse box “A” under the glove compartment, and fuse #7 (rear 12V socket) in the luggage compartment fuse box.

#### Volvo S60 | 2018-2025
The third-generation Volvo S60, produced from 2018 to 2025, represents a new era in Volvo’s mid-size luxury sedan lineup. Built on the SPA (Scalable Product Architecture) platform, it introduced electrification options including Twin-Engine and Recharge Plug-in Hybrid variants, while maintaining Volvo’s strong focus on Scandinavian design, advanced technology, and world-class safety. Offering a range of efficient engines, luxury features, and cutting-edge driver assistance systems, the S60 stands as one of Volvo’s most refined and eco-conscious sedans.

In this article, you will find fuse box diagrams for the Volvo S60, covering model years 2018, 2019, 2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024 and 2025. These diagrams are essential for identifying fuse layouts, enabling owners and technicians to locate, inspect, and replace fuses or relays as needed.

What’s Included:

Fuse Box Diagrams – Detailed visuals showing the arrangement of fuses and relays.

Fuse Panel Locations – Guidance on where to find fuse panels inside the Volvo S60.

Fuse Assignments – A full breakdown of each fuse and relay function to assist with diagnostics and repairs.

Whether you’re troubleshooting an electrical fault, replacing a blown fuse, or performing maintenance, this guide ensures your Volvo S60 (2018–2025) remains reliable, efficient, and safe.

FAQ

			
								
							
						
								
							
			What are the cigar lighter (power outlet) fuses in the Volvo S60?

Fuse #24 (front tunnel console), #25 (rear tunnel console), and #26 (trunk) in the engine compartment fuse box, plus fuse #2 (rear tunnel console outlet) under the glove compartment.

#### Volvo S80 | 1998-2006
The first-generation Volvo S80, produced from 1998 to 2006, marked a major shift in Volvo’s design philosophy, replacing the long-running 960/S90 sedan. With its rounded, modern styling, advanced safety systems, and comfortable interior, the S80 was positioned as Volvo’s flagship luxury sedan. It offered a wide range of engines, including inline-fives, sixes, and even a V8 in later years, delivering both refinement and performance.

In this article, you will find fuse box diagrams for the Volvo S80, covering model years 1998, 1999, 2000, 2001, 2002, 2003, 2004, 2005 and 2006. These diagrams provide crucial insights into the fuse layout, helping owners and technicians locate, check, and replace fuses or relays as needed.

What’s Included:

Fuse Box Diagrams – Clear illustrations showing the fuse and relay layout.

Fuse Panel Locations – Guidance on where the fuse panels are placed inside the Volvo S80.

Fuse Assignments – A complete list detailing the role of each fuse and relay for accurate troubleshooting.

Whether you’re dealing with an electrical fault, replacing a blown fuse, or performing preventive maintenance, this guide ensures your Volvo S80 (1998–2006) remains safe, functional, and reliable.

Fuse Box Locations

Engine compartment (A)

Relays/fuse box in the engine compartment.

Passenger compartment (B)

In the passenger compartment (this fuse box is located at the far left side of the instrument panel).

Luggage compartment (C)

Relays/fuse box in the trunk (it is located behind the left panel).

FAQ

			
								
							
						
								
							
			What are the cigar lighter (power outlet) fuses in the Volvo S80?

Fuse #13 in the instrument panel fuse box, and fuse #16 in the luggage compartment fuse box.

#### Volvo S80 | 2006-2010
The second-generation Volvo S80, before its facelift, was produced from 2006 to 2010. As Volvo’s flagship executive sedan, the S80 offered a blend of Scandinavian design, comfort, and advanced safety systems. Built on a refined platform, it featured a range of powertrains, luxury appointments, and cutting-edge driver aids, positioning it as a strong competitor in the premium sedan market.

In this article, you will find fuse box diagrams for the Volvo S80, covering model years 2006, 2007, 2008, 2009 and 2010. These diagrams are essential for understanding the fuse layout, helping owners and mechanics locate, inspect, and replace fuses or relays as needed.

What’s Included:

Fuse Box Diagrams – Easy-to-read visuals showing the arrangement of fuses and relays.

FAQ

			
								
							
						
								
							
			What are the cigar lighter (power outlet) fuses in the Volvo S80?

Fuse #25 (front and rear seat sockets) in the engine compartment fuse box, and fuse #6 (cargo socket) in the luggage compartment fuse box, module “A”.

#### Volvo S80 | 2011-2016
The second-generation Volvo S80, after a facelift, was produced from 2011 to 2016. As Volvo’s executive sedan, the S80 combined Scandinavian luxury with advanced safety technology, efficient engines, and a refined design. The facelift brought updated styling, modern infotainment features, and improved driver assistance systems, further enhancing its reputation as a premium, comfortable long-distance cruiser.

In this article, you will find fuse box diagrams for the Volvo S80, covering model years 2011, 2012, 2013, 2014, 2015 and 2016. These diagrams provide essential insights into the vehicle’s electrical system, helping owners, technicians, and enthusiasts with accurate maintenance and troubleshooting.

What’s Included:

Fuse Box Diagrams – Clear layouts showing the arrangement of fuses and relays.

Fuse Panel Locations – Guidance on where the fuse panels are situated inside the Volvo S80.

Fuse Assignments – Detailed explanations of what each fuse and relay controls, assisting with diagnostics and repairs.

Whether you’re replacing a fuse, diagnosing an electrical problem, or carrying out preventive maintenance, this guide ensures your Volvo S80 (2011–2016) remains dependable and fully functional.

FAQ

			
								
							
						
								
							
			What are the cigar lighter (power outlet) fuses in the Volvo S80?

Fuse #7 (trunk socket) and fuse #22 (12V sockets) in fuse box “A” under the glove compartment.

#### Volvo S90 | 2017-2025
The Volvo S90, a luxury sedan that embodies Scandinavian elegance and advanced safety technology, has been in production from 2016 to 2025. Known for its refined interior, cutting-edge driver assistance systems, and efficient powertrains—including Twin Engine and Recharge PHEV versions—the S90 stands as one of Volvo’s flagship executive cars.

In this article, you will find fuse box diagrams for the Volvo S90, covering model years 2017, 2018, 2019, 2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024 and 2025. These diagrams are an essential resource for understanding the electrical system, assisting owners, mechanics, and technicians with accurate diagnostics and maintenance.

What’s Included:

Fuse Box Diagrams – Detailed visuals of the fuse and relay layouts.

Fuse Panel Locations – Instructions on where to find the fuse panels inside the S90.

Fuse Assignments – Comprehensive explanations of each fuse and relay function to aid troubleshooting.

Whether you are replacing a blown fuse, diagnosing an electrical fault, or carrying out routine service, this guide ensures your Volvo S90 (2017–2025) remains reliable and fully operational.

In this article, you will find fuse box diagrams for the Volvo V60, covering model years 2010, 2011, 2012, 2013 and 2014. These diagrams are essential for identifying and troubleshooting issues related to fuses and relays within the vehicle.

What’s Included:

Fuse Box Diagrams – Detailed illustrations showing the layout of fuses and relays.

Fuse Panel Locations – Guidance on where to find the fuse panels inside the car (e.g., engine bay, dashboard, luggage compartment).

Fuse Assignments – Complete breakdowns of what each fuse and relay controls (such as wipers, headlights, infotainment, HVAC), making repairs more accurate.

Whether you&#8217;re diagnosing an electrical issue or replacing a blown fuse, this guide will help you effectively service your Volvo V60 (2010–2014).

FAQ

			
								
							
						
								
							
			What are the cigar lighter (power outlet) fuses in the Volvo V60?

Fuse #22 (12V socket, tunnel console) in the fuse box “A” under the glove compartment, and fuse #7 (12V socket, cargo area) in the cargo compartment fuse box.

#### Volvo V60 | 2015-2018
The first-generation Volvo V60 received a facelift in 2015, bringing updated styling, improved technology, and enhanced safety features. Produced until 2018, this version retained the V60’s well-known blend of luxury, practicality, and performance, appealing to drivers seeking both style and substance in a compact executive wagon.

In this article, you will find fuse box diagrams for the Volvo V60 (facelift), covering model years 2015, 2016, 2017 and 2018. These diagrams will assist you in identifying the correct fuse or relay related to various electrical systems in the vehicle.

What’s Included:

Fuse Box Diagrams – Clear visuals of each fuse and relay layout within the fuse panels.

Fuse Panel Locations – Step-by-step guidance on where the fuse boxes are situated inside the car, including under the hood, inside the passenger compartment, or in the luggage area.

Fuse Assignments – A detailed breakdown of what each fuse and relay controls (e.g., lighting, radio, climate control), making diagnostics and repairs more straightforward.

Whether you&#8217;re replacing a fuse or troubleshooting an electrical issue, this guide will help you maintain and service your Volvo V60 (2015–2018 facelift) with confidence.

Fuses A1, A2 and 1–11 are relays/circuit breakers and should only be removed or replaced by a trained and qualified Volvo service technician.Fuse 12 may be changed at any time when necessary.

FAQ

			
								
							
						
								
							
			What are the cigar lighter (power outlet) fuses in the Volvo V60?

Fuse #22 (12V sockets in tunnel console) in the fuse box “A” under the glove compartment, and fuse #7 (12V socket in cargo area) in the luggage compartment fuse box.

#### Volvo V60 | 2018-2025
The second-generation Volvo V60, available from 2018 to 2025, builds on Volvo’s reputation for safety, technology, and Scandinavian design. This model includes not only standard combustion variants but also Twin Engine and Recharge Plug-in Hybrid (PHEV) versions, making it a versatile and efficient luxury wagon.

In this article, you will find fuse box diagrams for the Volvo V60, covering model years 2018, 2019, 2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024 and 2025. These diagrams are essential for identifying and servicing electrical components such as lights, audio systems, power outlets, and more.

What’s Included:

Fuse Box Diagrams – Detailed layouts showing the position of each fuse and relay within the panels.

Fuse Panel Locations – Step-by-step guidance on locating the fuse boxes inside the car, typically found in the engine compartment, passenger footwell, or cargo area.

Fuse Assignments – A complete list explaining what each fuse and relay controls, useful for diagnostics and repairs.

Whether you&#8217;re replacing a blown fuse or troubleshooting a malfunctioning system, this guide will help you navigate the Volvo V60 (2018–2025) fuse layout confidently and efficiently.

FAQ

			
								
							
						
								
							
			What are the cigar lighter (power outlet) fuses in the Volvo V70 / XC70?

Fuse #7 (cargo area) and fuse #22 (tunnel console) in fuse box “A” under the glovebox.

#### Volvo V90 | 2016-2025
The luxury station wagon Volvo V90, introduced in 2016, offers a blend of refined Scandinavian design, spacious practicality, and advanced safety and infotainment technologies. Built on Volvo’s SPA (Scalable Product Architecture) platform, it is available with a range of efficient powertrains, including mild-hybrid, Twin Engine plug-in hybrid, and Recharge PHEV variants. Production continues through 2025.

In this article, you will find fuse box diagrams for the Volvo V90, covering model years 2016, 2017, 2018, 2019, 2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024 and 2025. These diagrams help identify the correct fuses and relays used to protect essential electrical components and systems.

What’s Included:

Fuse Box Diagrams – Visual references showing fuse and relay layouts by model year and configuration.

Fuse Panel Locations – Guidance on locating each fuse panel (e.g., passenger compartment, cargo area, engine bay).

Fuse Assignments – Comprehensive tables showing what each fuse and relay controls, making diagnosis and replacement easier.

Whether you&#8217;re troubleshooting an electrical problem or installing accessories, this guide will help you maintain and service your Volvo V90 (2016–2025) with confidence.

FAQ

			
								
							
						
								
							
			What are the cigar lighter (power outlet) fuses in the Volvo V90?

Fuses #24, #25, and #26 in the engine compartment fuse box, and fuse #2 (optional 120/230V socket) under the glovebox.

#### Volvo XC40 | 2017-2025
The compact luxury crossover Volvo XC40, introduced in 2017, marked Volvo’s entry into the premium compact SUV segment. Built on the CMA (Compact Modular Architecture) platform, it blends Scandinavian design, advanced safety features, and versatile interior space. Available in both internal combustion and electrified variants—including mild-hybrid, plug-in hybrid, and fully electric (Recharge) models—it continues production through 2025.

In this article, you will find fuse box diagrams for the Volvo XC40, covering model years 2017, 2018, 2019, 2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024 and 2025. These diagrams are essential for identifying the correct fuses and relays that protect and control various electrical components throughout the vehicle.

What’s Included:

Fuse Box Diagrams – Clear illustrations of the fuse and relay layouts by year and configuration.

Fuse Panel Locations – Step-by-step details on where to locate each fuse box (e.g., under the hood, behind panels, under the glove box).

Fuse Assignments – A full table showing what each fuse and relay controls, simplifying diagnosis and replacement.

Whether you’re troubleshooting a power window issue, replacing a faulty fuse, or configuring accessories, this guide will help you service and support your Volvo XC40 (2017–2025) accurately.

			What are the cigar lighter (power outlet) fuses in the Volvo XC40?

Fuse #2 (front 12V socket) and fuse #4 (cargo area 12V socket, if equipped) in the engine compartment fuse box.

			What are the cigar lighter (power outlet) fuses in the Volvo XC60 (2008–2012)?

FAQ

			
								
							
						
								
							
			What are the cigar lighter (power outlet) fuses in the Volvo XC60?

In the fuse box “A” under the glove compartment:
Fuse #7 – 12-volt socket in the cargo areaFuse #22 – 12-volt sockets in the tunnel console

#### Volvo XC60 | 2017-2025
The second-generation Volvo XC60, introduced in 2017 and continuing through 2025, builds on Volvo’s reputation for safety, luxury, and advanced technology. Available in a variety of powertrains—including Twin Engine and Recharge PHEV (Plug-in Hybrid Electric Vehicle) models—this premium mid-size SUV offers a refined driving experience combined with cutting-edge electrical systems.

In this article, you will find fuse box diagrams for the Volvo XC60, covering model years 2017, 2018, 2019, 2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024 and 2025. These diagrams are essential for identifying, inspecting, or replacing fuses and relays tied to various vehicle systems.

What’s Included:

Fuse Box Diagrams – Accurate layouts showing the positions of fuses and relays for each model year.

Fuse Panel Locations – Step-by-step guidance on where to find each fuse box inside the vehicle (such as behind panels or under the hood).

Fuse Assignments – Comprehensive lists detailing which systems each fuse and relay supports.

Whether you&#8217;re diagnosing an electrical issue or replacing a blown fuse, this guide will help you maintain the functionality and reliability of your Volvo XC60 (2017–2025).

FAQ

			
								
							
						
								
							
			What are the cigar lighter (power outlet) fuses in the Volvo XC60?

Engine compartment fuse box:Fuse #24 – 12V outlet in front tunnel consoleFuse #25 – 12V outlet between rear seatsFuse #26 – 12V outlet in cargo compartment
Under-glovebox fuse box:Fuse #2 – 230V socket in tunnel console

#### Volvo XC90 | 2002-2014
The first-generation Volvo XC90, produced from 2002 to 2014, was Volvo’s debut entry into the mid-size luxury SUV market. Known for its emphasis on safety, spacious interior, and family-friendly features, the XC90 quickly became a popular choice among SUV buyers during its production run.

In this article, you will find fuse box diagrams for the Volvo XC90, covering model years 2002, 2003, 2004, 2005, 2006, 2007, 2008, 2009, 2010, 2011, 2012, 2013 and 2014. These diagrams are helpful for locating, inspecting, or replacing fuses and relays associated with various electrical systems.

What’s Included:

Fuse Box Diagrams – Clear illustrations showing the fuse and relay layout for each model year.

Fuse Panel Locations – Guidance on where to find fuse panels inside the vehicle, such as in the passenger compartment or engine bay.

Fuse Assignments – Detailed descriptions of what each fuse and relay controls, aiding in diagnostics and repairs.

Whether you’re troubleshooting an electrical fault or replacing a blown fuse, this guide will help you keep your Volvo XC90 (2002–2014) in top working condition.

Fuse Box Locations

1) Engine compartment

2) Passenger compartment, below the steering wheel

This fuse box is located behind the plastic cover under the dashboard.

3) Passenger compartment, on the edge of the dashboard

Fuses are located inside the access panel on the edge of the dashboard, on the driver’s side.

4) Cargo compartment

These fuses in the cargo area are located behind the panel on the driver’s side of the cargo compartment.

5) Cargo compartment (XC90 Executive)

FAQ

			
								
							
						
								
							
			What are the cigar lighter (power outlet) fuses in the Volvo XC90?

Fuse #11 – Front and rear seat 12V sockets (located below the steering wheel)Fuse #8 – Cargo compartment 12V socket (located in the luggage compartment fuse box)

#### Volvo XC90 | 2015-2025
The second-generation Volvo XC90, including the Twin-Engine and Recharge Plug-in Hybrid versions, has been available from 2015 to 2025. Known for its elegant Scandinavian design, advanced safety technology, and luxurious interior, this generation marked a significant leap in Volvo&#8217;s approach to premium SUVs.

In this article, you will find fuse box diagrams for the Volvo XC90, covering model years 2015, 2016, 2017, 2018, 2019, 2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024 and 2025. These diagrams are essential for identifying fuse panel locations and understanding the function of each fuse and relay, especially in hybrid and plug-in hybrid configurations.

What’s Included:

Fuse Box Diagrams – Detailed visuals for each model year showing the arrangement of fuses and relays.

Fuse Panel Locations – Instructions on where to find fuse panels in the vehicle (e.g., engine compartment, passenger compartment, cargo area).

Fuse Assignments – A complete breakdown of what each fuse and relay controls, helping you with diagnostics and maintenance.

Whether you&#8217;re replacing a fuse or diagnosing an electrical problem, this guide will assist you in maintaining the functionality and reliability of your Volvo XC90 (2015–2025).

FAQ

			
								
							
						
								
							
			What are the cigar lighter (power outlet) fuses in the Volvo XC90?

The fuses are:
#24, #25, #26 – Located in the engine compartment fuse box#2 – For the electrical outlet in the tunnel console, located in the fuse box under the glovebox.

Passenger Compartment

Fuse Box (C)

Fuse Box Location

Left-Hand Drive

Open and, if necessary, empty the storage compartment.

Press the retaining tabs upward in the direction of the arrow and, at the same time, open the storage compartment further and remove it until the fuse panel is accessible.

To install: Press the storage compartment into the instrument panel mounts until it locks into place on both sides and then close the compartment

Right-Hand Drive

Open the glove box, and empty it if necessary.

Push the damper element up and into the opening in the bracket, before pulling it out sideways.

Press the stop pin upward in the direction of the arrow.

To install: move the storage compartment into position. Fit the damper element into the opening in the bracket and push it down until you hear it click into place. Push the storage compartment carefully forwards past the resistance of the stop pin.

#### VW Beetle | 1998-2011
Looking for Volkswagen New Beetle fuse box diagrams? This article covers the compact Volkswagen New Beetle, produced from 1998 to 2011, and includes fuse box diagrams for Volkswagen Beetle 1998, 1999, 2000, 2001, 2002, 2003, 2004, 2005, 2006, 2007, 2008, 2009, 2010 and 2011, along with details about the location of the fuse panels inside the vehicle and a clear explanation of the assignment of each fuse and relay (fuse layout).

What’s Included
Toggle
Fuse Box LocationsPre-Fuse BoxRelay BoxDashboard Fuse BoxGlow Period Control UnitAdditional RelaysFuse Box DiagramsDashboard Fuse BoxFusesRelay BoxPre-Fuse BoxHigh Voltage FusesAdditional RelaysRelaysFAQ
Fuse Box Locations

Pre-Fuse Box

Fuses on the battery (in the engine compartment)

Relay Box

Relay panelThe panel is located underneath the steering wheel on the underside of the dash panel.

Dashboard Fuse Box

Fuses in the dash panelThe fuses are located on the left side of the dash panel behind a cover.

Glow Period Control Unit

Automatic glow period control unitIt is located in the center of plenum chamber (engine code BEW only, from June 2003 up to December 2006 only).

Additional Relays

Additional relay carrierLocated in the protective housing on left in the engine compartment (from model year 2002 up to model year 2005)

FAQ

			
								
							
						
								
							
			Where are the cigar lighter (power outlet) fuses in the Volkswagen New Beetle?

They are fuses #27, #35, and #41 in the instrument panel fuse box.

#### VW Beetle | 2012-2019
Looking for Volkswagen Beetle fuse box diagrams? This article covers the Volkswagen Beetle (Model Code: A5), produced from 2011 to 2019 (also known as Volkswagen Käfer, Coccinelle, Maggiolino, and Fusca in some markets), and includes fuse box diagrams for Volkswagen Beetle 2011, 2012, 2013, 2014, 2015, 2016, 2017, 2018 and 2019, along with details about the location of the fuse panels inside the vehicle and a clear explanation of the assignment of each fuse and relay (fuse layout).

Passenger Compartment (SC)

Fuse Box Location

Opening the fuse box in the instrument panel:

Open the storage compartment.

On the back of the cover there are plastic tweezers for removing and inserting fuses.

Press the sides of the storage compartment in slightly (A arrows) while pulling back firmly (B arrow).

To install, guide the cover from the bottom into the instrument panel and push in the direction opposite to the arrow (B) until you hear the hinges click into place, then push forward until the cover latches firmly.

Engine Compartment (SA, SB)

Fuse Box Location

Opening the fuse box in the engine compartment:

Open the engine hood.

Move the release tabs in the direction of the arrows to unlock the fuse box cover.

Remove the cover upward.

To install push the cover onto the fuse box. The locking tabs must latch with an audible “click”.

Fuse Box (C)

Fuse Box Location

The fuse box is located on the dashboard, below and to the left of the steering wheel.

#### VW Crafter | 2007-2015
Looking for Volkswagen Crafter fuse box diagrams? This article covers the first-generation Volkswagen Crafter, produced from 2006 to 2017, and includes fuse box diagrams for Volkswagen Crafter 2007, 2008, 2009, 2010, 2011, 2012, 2013, 2014 and 2015, along with details about the location of the fuse panels inside the vehicle and a clear explanation of the assignment of each fuse (fuse layout).

#### VW e-Up! | 2013-2023
Looking for Volkswagen Up fuse box diagrams? This article covers the city car Volkswagen Up, available from 2011 to 2023, and includes fuse box diagrams for Volkswagen Up 2011, 2012, 2013, 2014, 2015, 2016, 2017, 2018, 2019, 2020, 2021, 2022 and 2023, along with information about the location of the fuse panels inside the car and the assignment of each fuse (fuse layout), making it easier to understand and troubleshoot the vehicle’s electrical system.

Engine Compartment

Fuse Box Location

The fuses are located underneath a cover on the vehicle battery.

Passenger Compartment

Fuse Box Location (C)

The fuses are located underneath the steering wheel on the underside of the dash panel.

Push the locking lever (1) until the cover can be opened.

Fold the cover down.

FAQ

			
								
							
						
								
							
			Where is the cigar lighter (power outlet) fuse in the Volkswagen Fox?

It is fuse #48 in the passenger compartment fuse box (-SB- holder).

Engine Compartment

Fuse Box Location (SA, SB)

Opening the fuse box in the engine compartment:

Slide the release buttons forward in the direction of the arrows to unlock the fuse box cover.

Remove the cover upward.

To install, place the cover on the fuse box. Slide release buttons backward against the direction of the arrows until they latch with an audible “click”.

Passenger Compartment

Fuse Box Location (SC)

Opening the fuse box in the instrument panel:

Insert a flat object, such as a screwdriver from the vehicle tool kit, into the opening (magnified view) and carefully lift off the cover.

To install, guide the cover from the bottom into the instrument panel and push until you can hear it latch into place.

#### VW Golf | 2012-2020
Looking for Volkswagen Golf fuse box diagrams? This article covers the seventh-generation Volkswagen Golf (Mk7), produced from 2012 to 2020, and includes fuse box diagrams for Volkswagen Golf (Mk7) 2012, 2013, 2014, 2015, 2016, 2017, 2018, 2019 and 2020, along with details about the location of the fuse panels inside the vehicle and a clear explanation of the assignment of each fuse (fuse layout).

Engine Compartment

Fuse Box Location (-SA-, -SB-)

Press the release tabs in the direction of the arrows to unlock the fuse box cover 1.

Remove the cover upward.

To install push the cover onto the fuse box. The locking tabs must latch with an audible click.

Passenger Compartment

Fuse Box Location

Pull the lower part of the cover straight out (in the direction of the arrow) and remove the cover from the bottom. This action may require moderate force.

To install, guide the cover from the bottom into the instrument panel and push in the direction opposite to the arrow until you can hear it latch into place.

#### VW Golf | 2020-2026
Looking for Volkswagen Golf fuse box diagrams? This article covers the eighth-generation Volkswagen Golf (Model Codes: CD1, CG5), produced from 2019, and includes fuse box diagrams for Volkswagen Golf (MK8) 2019, 2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025 and 2026, along with details about the location of the fuse panels inside the vehicle and a clear explanation of the assignment of each fuse and relay (fuse layout).

Passenger Compartment (-SC-)

Fuse Box Location

Left-Hand Drive

For left-hand drive vehicles: Reach behind the cover and pull it off in the direction of the arrow.

Right-Hand Drive

For right-hand drive vehicles: Push the damper element up and into the opening in the bracket, before pulling it out side-ways (1). Push the catches up in the direction of the arrow while at the same time opening the storage compartment further (2).

Passenger Compartment

Fuse Box Location

The fuse box is located behind the cover on the driver’s side. Pull the lower part of the cover in the direction of the arrow and remove the cover from the bottom. On the inside of the cover there are plastic tweezers for removing and inserting fuses.

#### VW Multivan | 2022-2026
Looking for Volkswagen Multivan fuse box diagrams? This article covers the seventh-generation Volkswagen Multivan (Model Code: T7), produced from 2022, and includes fuse box diagrams for Volkswagen Multivan (T7) 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025 and 2026, along with details about the location of the fuse panels inside the vehicle and a clear explanation of the assignment of each fuse and relay (fuse layout).

FAQ

			
								
							
						
								
							
			Where is the cigar lighter (power outlet) fuse in the Volkswagen Passat?

Instrument panel fuse box: fuses #33 and #17Auxiliary relay panel (above relay panel): fuses “A” and “B”

#### VW Passat | 2005-2010
Looking for Volkswagen Passat fuse box diagrams? This article covers the Volkswagen Passat (Model Code: B6), produced from 2005 to 2010, and includes fuse box diagrams for Volkswagen Passat 2005, 2006, 2007, 2008, 2009 and 2010, along with details about the location of the fuse panels inside the vehicle and a clear explanation of the assignment of each fuse and relay (fuse layout).

Engine Compartment

Fuse Box Location

Open the engine hood.

Move the release buttons (1) in the direction of the arrows to unlock the fuse box cover.

Remove the cover (2) upward.

To install, place the cover on the fuse box. Slide release buttons against the direction of the arrows until they latch with an audible “click”.

Additional Fuse

70A – Saloon / 60A – Variant

#### VW Passat | 2010-2015
Looking for Volkswagen Passat fuse box diagrams? This article covers the Volkswagen Passat (Model Code: B7), produced from 2010 to 2015, and includes fuse box diagrams for Volkswagen Passat (B7) 2010, 2011, 2012, 2013, 2014 and 2015, along with details about the location of the fuse panels inside the vehicle and a clear explanation of the assignment of each fuse and relay (fuse layout).

Fuse Box Overview

1&nbsp;– Pre-Fuse box (Fuse holder A -SA-);2&nbsp;– Relay carrier under electronics box;3&nbsp;– Terminal 30 wiring junction;4&nbsp;– Heated windscreen relay;In plenum chamber next to engine control unit;5&nbsp;– Fuses on left under dash panel;6&nbsp;– Fuse holder on the right side edge of the instrument panel (Fuse holder D -SD-);7&nbsp;– Relays on onboard supply control unit;8&nbsp;– Fuses in the luggage compartment (Fuse holder F -SF-);There are additional fuses above the vehicle battery behind the panel on the left side of the luggage Compartment.9&nbsp;– Fuse 2 (30) -S205- (60 A);10&nbsp;– Fuse holder on the left side edge of the instrument panel (Fuse holder C -SC-);11&nbsp;– Relay carrier 1 on left under dash panel;12&nbsp;– Relay carrier 2 on left under dash panel;13&nbsp;– Relay carrier under electronics box;14&nbsp;– Fuse box in the Engine compartment (Fuse holder B -SB-)[/ads_col][/ads_row].

#### VW Passat | 2014-2019
Looking for Volkswagen Passat fuse box diagrams? This article covers the eighth-generation Volkswagen Passat (Model Code: B8) before the facelift, produced from 2014 to 2019, and includes fuse box diagrams for Volkswagen Passat (B8) 2014, 2015, 2016, 2017, 2018 and 2019, along with information about the location of the fuse panels inside the vehicle and a clear explanation of the assignment of each fuse and relay (fuse layout).

Passenger Compartment

Fuse Box Locations

Left-Hand Drive

Reach behind the cover and pull it off in the direction of the arrow.

Right-Hand Drive

Open the glove compartment and empty it if necessary.

Push the brake element upward into the opening of the bracket and pull it out sideways in the direction of the arrow (1).

Press the stop pin upwards in the direction of the arrow, while at the same time opening the glove compartment further (2).

#### VW Phaeton | 2004-2016
Looking for Volkswagen Phaeton fuse box diagrams? This article covers the luxury sedan Volkswagen Phaeton (Model Codes: GP0, GP1, GP2, GP3, GP4), produced from 2002 to 2016, and includes fuse box diagrams for Volkswagen Phaeton 2004, 2005, 2006, 2007, 2008, 2009, 2010, 2011, 2012, 2013, 2014, 2015 and 2016, along with information about the location of the fuse panels inside the vehicle and a clear explanation of the assignment of each fuse and relay (fuse layout).

#### VW Polo | 1995-2002
Looking for Volkswagen Polo fuse box diagrams? This article covers the third-generation Volkswagen Polo (Model Codes: 6N, 6KV), produced from 1994 to 2002, and includes fuse box diagrams for Volkswagen Polo 1995, 1996, 1997, 1998, 1999, 2000, 2001 and 2002, along with details about the location of the fuse panels inside the vehicle and a clear explanation of the assignment of each fuse and relay (fuse layout).

2014-2017 (-SA-)

Figure shows fuse holder A -SA- for models with battery in engine compartment.

In models with battery in luggage compartment, fuse holder A -SA- is fitted lengthways.

The fuse strip (multifuse) must be replaced as a complete unit.

For models with battery in engine compartment, from November 2014, fuse 5 on fuse holder A -SA5- is not present. This connection is therefore bridged. In the line (16.0 mm2, red), connected to -SA5- in the illustration, there is an inline fuse (single fuse in wiring harness coiled under the battery carrier), fuse 1 (30) – S204- (125A).

Fuse 1 (30) – S204- can only be accessed when the battery and battery holder are removed.

#### VW Sharan | 1995-2009
Before Facelift

After Facelift

Looking for Volkswagen Sharan fuse box diagrams? This article covers the first-generation Volkswagen Sharan (Model Code: 7M), produced from 1995 to 2010, and includes fuse box diagrams for Volkswagen Sharan 1995, 1996, 1997, 1998, 1999, 2000, 2001, 2002, 2003, 2004, 2005, 2006, 2007, 2008 and 2009, along with information about the location of the fuse panels inside the vehicle and a clear explanation of the assignment of each fuse and relay (fuse layout).

#### VW T-Roc | 2017-2025
Need Volkswagen T-Roc fuse box diagrams without digging through manuals? This guide focuses on the first-generation Volkswagen T-Roc (model codes A11/D11, AC7/AC8 Cabriolet), produced from 2017 to 2025, and covers Volkswagen T-Roc 2017, 2018, 2019, 2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024 and 2025, showing the exact fuse panel locations, clearly explaining the fuse layout, and identifying each fuse and relay, so troubleshooting electrical gremlins feels more like a quick fix than a treasure hunt.

Passenger Compartment

Fuse Box Location

Left-Hand Driver

Under the steering wheel. Reach behind the cover and pull it forward.

Right-Hand Drive

Open the stowage compartment on the front passenger side and remove the contents if necessary.

Slide the braking element (1) downwards into the opening in the holder and pull it out sideways.

Push catches (2) upwards in the direction of the arrow whilst opening the stowage compartment further.

#### VW Tiguan | 2012-2016
Looking for Volkswagen Tiguan fuse box diagrams? This article covers the first-generation facelifted Volkswagen Tiguan (Model Code: 5N), produced from 2012 to 2016, and includes fuse box diagrams for Volkswagen Tiguan 2012, 2013, 2014, 2015 and 2016, along with information about the location of the fuse panels inside the vehicle and a detailed breakdown of the assignment of each fuse and relay (fuse layout).

Passenger Compartment

Fuse Box Location

Left-hand Drive

Open the stowage compartment on the driver side.

Empty stowage compartment if necessary.

Push the retaining lugs (1) upwards in the direction of the arrow whilst opening the stowage compartment until the fuse carrier can be accessed.

To install, press the stowage compartment into the mounts on the dash panel until it audibly clicks into place on both sides and then close the compartment.

Right-hand Drive

Open the stowage compartment on the front passenger side and remove the contents if necessary.

Slide the braking element (1) downwards into the opening in the holder and pull it out sideways.

Push catches (2) upwards in the direction of the arrow whilst opening the stowage compartment further.

To install: bring storage compartment into position. Insert the brake element in the holder opening and push upwards until it audibly engages. Carefully push the stowage compartment forwards beyond the resistance of the catches (2).

Passenger Compartment

Fuse Box Location

Left-Hand Driver

Removing the cover:

Open the storage compartment on the driver’s side and empty it, if necessary.

Open the storage compartment on the driver’s side further in the direction of the arrow and pull it out.

Fitting the cover:

Press the storage compartment into the mounts in the instrument panel until you hear the catch engage on both sides.

Close the storage compartment on the driver side.

Right-Hand Driver

Removing the cover:

Open the glove compartment and empty it if necessary.

Push the damper element (1) in the direction of the arrow and into the opening in the bracket, before pulling it out sideways.

Push the catches up in the direction of the arrow while at the same time opening the storage compartment further (2).

Fitting the cover:

Move the storage compartment into position.

Fit the damper element (1) into the opening in the bracket and push it in the opposite direction to the arrow until you hear it click into place.

Push the storage compartment carefully forwards past the resistance of the stop pin (2).

Passenger Compartment (C)

Fuse Box Location

Left-Hand Drive

The fuse box is located to the left of the steering wheel, behind the dash panel fuse box cover (left-hand drive vehicles).

Removing the cover:

Open the driver-side stowage compartment and remove any contents if necessary.

Open the stowage compartment further in the direction of the arrow and pull it out to access the fuse box.

Right-Hand Drive

The fuse box is located on the front passenger side, behind the dash panel fuse box cover.

Removing the cover:

Open the glove box and remove any contents if necessary.

Push the restrictor upward into the holder opening and pull it out to the side in the direction of the arrow.

Push the catches upward in the direction of the arrow while opening the glove box further to access the fuse box.

FAQ

			
								
							
						
								
							
			Where are the cigar lighter (power outlet) fuses in the Volkswagen Touareg?

They are located in the left instrument panel fuse box:Fuse #1 – Cigarette lighterFuse #3 – 12 V socket (rear right / rear cigarette lighter)Fuse #5 – 12 V sockets (front center console and rear)

#### VW Touareg | 2006-2010
Looking for Volkswagen Touareg fuse box diagrams? This article covers the first-generation Volkswagen Touareg (Model Code: 7L) after a facelift, produced from 2006 to 2010, and includes fuse box diagrams for Volkswagen Touareg (7L) 2006, 2007, 2008, 2009 and 2010, along with information about the location of the fuse panels inside the vehicle and a detailed breakdown of the assignment of each fuse and relay (fuse layout).

FAQ

			
								
							
						
								
							
			Where are the cigar lighter (power outlet) fuses in the Volkswagen Touareg?

They are fuses #1, #2, #3, and #5 in the left instrument panel fuse box.

#### VW Touareg | 2010-2018
Looking for Volkswagen Touareg fuse box diagrams? This article covers the second-generation Volkswagen Touareg (Model Code: 7P), produced from 2010 to 2018, and includes fuse box diagrams for Volkswagen Touareg (7P) 2010, 2011, 2012, 2013, 2014, 2015, 2016, 2017 and 2018, along with information about the location of the fuse panels inside the vehicle and a detailed breakdown of the assignment of each fuse and relay (fuse layout).

#### VW Touareg | 2018-2026
Looking for Volkswagen Touareg fuse box diagrams? This article covers the third-generation Volkswagen Touareg (Model Code: CR), available from 2018 to 2026, and includes fuse box diagrams for Volkswagen Touareg 2018, 2019, 2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025 and 2026, along with information about the location of the fuse panels inside the vehicle and a detailed breakdown of the assignment of each fuse (fuse layout).

#### VW Touran | 2010-2015
In this article, we cover Volkswagen Touran (1T) fuse box diagrams, relay layouts, fuse panel locations, and fuse assignments for the first-generation Touran after the second facelift (2010–2015). You will find fuse box diagrams for the 2010, 2011, 2012, 2013, 2014, and 2015 Volkswagen Touran (1T), along with information on the location of the fuse panels inside the vehicle and the assignment of each fuse and relay (fuse layout).

#### VW Touran | 2015-2026
Looking for Volkswagen Touran fuse box diagrams? This article covers the second-generation Volkswagen Touran (Model Code: 5T), available from 2015 to 2026, and includes fuse box diagrams for Volkswagen Touran (5T) 2016, 2017, 2018, 2019, 2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025 and 2026, along with information about the location of the fuse panels inside the vehicle and a clear breakdown of the assignment of each fuse and relay (fuse layout).

Fuse Box Location

Press the release buttons in the direction of the arrow to release the fuse box cover (1). In some vehicles, there is a pair of plastic pliers for removing fuses on the inside of the cover.

#### VW Transporter / Caravelle | 2010-2015
Looking for Volkswagen Transporter / Caravelle fuse box diagrams? This article covers the facelifted fifth-generation Volkswagen Transporter / Caravelle (Model Code: T5.1), produced from 2009 to 2015, and includes fuse box diagrams for Volkswagen Transporter / Caravelle (T5.1) 2010, 2011, 2012, 2013, 2014 and 2015, along with information about the location of the fuse panels inside the vehicle and the assignment of each fuse (fuse layout).

#### VW Transporter / Caravelle | 2015-2019
Looking for Volkswagen Transporter / Caravelle fuse box diagrams? This article covers the sixth-generation (pre-facelift) Volkswagen Transporter / Caravelle (Model Code: T6), produced from 2015 to 2019, and includes detailed diagrams for Volkswagen Transporter / Caravelle (T6) 2015, 2016, 2017, 2018 and 2019, along with information about the location of the fuse panels inside the vehicle and a clear breakdown of the assignment of each fuse and relay (fuse layout).

#### VW Transporter / Caravelle | 2019-2024
Looking for Volkswagen Transporter / Caravelle fuse box diagrams? This article covers the facelifted sixth-generation Volkswagen Transporter / Caravelle (Model Code: T6.1), produced from 2019 to 2024, and includes detailed diagrams for Volkswagen Transporter / Caravelle (T6.1) 2019, 2020, 2021, 2022, 2023 and 2024, along with information about the location of the fuse panels inside the vehicle and a clear breakdown of the assignment of each fuse and relay (fuse layout).

Engine Compartment

There are two fuse boxes located in the engine compartment: Fuse Holder “A” and Fuse Holder “B”.

Fuse Box Location (A/B)

The fuses are located underneath a cover on the vehicle battery.

The fuse strip (multifuse) must be replaced as a complete unit.

Passenger Compartment

Fuse Box Location (C)

The fuses are located underneath the steering wheel on the underside of the dash panel.

Push the locking lever (1) until the cover can be opened.

Fold the cover down.

#### About
Fuse Box Insights

About FuBox – Your Trusted Source for Fuse Box Diagrams

FuBox is an online automotive resource built to help drivers, DIY mechanics, and professional technicians quickly find accurate fuse box diagrams, relay layouts, and fuse panel locations for thousands of vehicle models. Our goal is to simplify vehicle electrical system troubleshooting by providing clear, model-specific information in one easy-to-use platform.Founded by a team of automotive enthusiasts and technical specialists, FuBox was created to solve a common problem: the lack of reliable, well-organized car fuse box information on the web. We understood the frustration of searching through manuals and forums, so we built a centralized database that delivers fast, precise, and up-to-date electrical system data.Today, FuBox serves a global audience of car owners, DIY enthusiasts, and professional auto technicians who rely on our detailed diagrams to diagnose electrical faults, locate blown fuses, and restore vehicle electrical functions efficiently. Whether you need the fuse layout for headlights, radio, power windows, or engine components, FuBox is your go-to reference for accurate automotive fuse information.

Our Core Values
At FuBox, our values define our commitment to providing reliable fuse box information, precise vehicle electrical diagrams, and a high-quality troubleshooting experience for car owners and professionals.

Integrity
We are committed to honesty, accuracy, and transparency in everything we publish. Every fuse box diagram and electrical layout on FuBox is carefully reviewed so our users can trust the information for safe and reliable troubleshooting.

Innovation
We continuously improve our platform by adopting new technologies and updating our database with the latest vehicle fuse box diagrams, relay layouts, and electrical system data to ensure the highest level of accuracy and coverage.

Customer Focus
Our users come first. From DIY car owners to professional mechanics, we are dedicated to delivering easy-to-use, dependable electrical resources along with responsive support that exceeds expectations.
